body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：曼徹斯特建築學院（Manchester School of Architecture, MSA）的 Master of Landscape Architecture（MLA）由曼徹斯特大學與曼徹斯特都會大學（MMU）聯合開辦。官網 2027 entry 標示學制為全日制 1 年或兼讀 2 年，但實際依背景分 Part 1→Part 2（轉科／國際生常見約兩年）、Architecture Conversion Route（1 月入學再銜接 Part 2）與直接 Part 2（具認可景觀本科學歷者約一年）。2027 學費尚未公布；參考 2026 年 9 月入學：英國本地每年 £12,400、國際生每年 £28,500（由 MMU 收取）。申請系統預計 2026 年 10 月 10 日開放 2027/28 碩士申請；作品集（線上最多約 12 頁）與面試為評估核心。Part 1 英文 IELTS 總分 6.5（各項≥5.5）；直接 Part 2 為 6.5（各項≥6.0）。課程正進行 Landscape Institute 認證複審，官網提醒認證非保證。

以下於 2026 年 10 月對照 UoM 2027 entry 課程頁、MSA MLA／Apply 頁與碩士申請說明查核。

文首封面取自 MSA MLA 學生作品庫的景觀總平面（無人物）。圖片來源：Manchester School of Architecture MLA

MLA 三條路徑分別是什麼？

  • Part 1：給相關科系轉換與需適應英國專業語境的申請者；六門課共 120 學分，含導入景觀、種植與技術、理論、生物多樣性與氣候調適、社區、研究等，再進入 Part 2。
  • Architecture Conversion Route：給英國 RIBA／ARB 建築本科（或同等）轉換者；兩門特設課後於同年 9 月進入 Part 2。
  • Part 2：最終年，atelier 研究設計、論文／展覽與專業實踐等（約 180 學分）；可直接入學（需認可景觀本科學歷或 IFLA 同等）。

申請條件、作品集與英文？

  • Part 1 背景示例：建築／都市設計／規劃／室內／花園設計，或其他設計或土地／植物科學、工程等；適配度以作品集＋面試評估。
  • 直接 Part 2：英國認可景觀本科二等榮譽起，或 IFLA 認可同等；密切相關學科（如建築、都市設計）須另證 Level 6 景觀知識。
  • 作品集：線上最多約 12 頁；無藝術設計背景可用研究摘要、標註攝影／繪圖等證明場所觀察；少數個案可能加詳細作品集面試。
  • 英文：Part 1／轉換路徑 IELTS 6.5（各項≥5.5）；直接 Part 2 為 6.5（各項≥6.0）或同等。

學費、申請時程與認證狀態？

  • 學費：2027 未定；參考 2026：UK £12,400／年、國際 £28,500／年（MMU 收取）。另有材料等估計費用（官網列 compulsory 約 £1,700 等）。國際生可能獲 £3,000 首年獎學金（符合者自動評估）。
  • 申請：2027/28 碩士申請自 2026/10/10 開放；個別課程截止以課程頁為準。先讀 MSA How to Apply 的作品集說明再送件。
  • 認證：修訂後 MLA 正由 Landscape Institute 全面複審；官網寫明認證非保證，請追蹤頁面更新。
  • 比較：若同時看港台景觀／規劃，可參 中大 MLA、中大可持續城市規劃。

轉科申請景觀，作品集該準備什麼？

作者建議（非官方要求）：MSA 明確說看重適配度而非「完成度很高的藝術品」。在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，建築轉景觀者常只交建築圖；更有效的是補上場所閱讀、植被／水文觀察與社區尺度的一至兩個項目，並能在面試說清為何景觀（而非建築）是你的下一個工具。

官方來源：UoM MLA 2027、MSA MLA、MSA Apply、UoM How to apply（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: The Master of Landscape Architecture (MLA) at Manchester School of Architecture is jointly delivered by the University of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University. The 2027-entry page lists 1 year full-time or 2 years part-time, but routes include Part 1→Part 2 (typical conversion/international path), an Architecture Conversion Route (January start into Part 2), and direct Part 2 (about one year for accredited landscape undergraduates). 2027 fees are not yet set; 2026 reference fees are £12,400 (UK) / £28,500 (international) per year, collected by MMU. 2027/28 master’s applications open 10 October 2026. Portfolio (online, up to ~12 pages) plus interview are central. IELTS 6.5 (subscores ≥5.5 for Part 1; ≥6.0 for direct Part 2). LI accreditation is under full review and not guaranteed.

Checked October 2026 against the UoM 2027 course page, MSA MLA/Apply pages and UoM how-to-apply guidance.

Cover: a people-free landscape masterplan from the MSA MLA student-work set. Image source: MSA MLA

What are the three routes?

  • Part 1: conversion / transition year; six modules, 120 credits, then Part 2.
  • Architecture Conversion Route: for RIBA/ARB (or equivalent) architecture graduates; two modules, then Part 2 in September of the same year.
  • Part 2: final year (~180 credits) with atelier design, dissertation/exhibition and professional practice; direct entry for accredited landscape bachelor’s / IFLA equivalent.

Entry, portfolio and English?

  • Part 1 backgrounds: built-environment design and related arts, land/plant sciences or engineering, assessed by portfolio and interview.
  • Direct Part 2: accredited UK landscape undergraduate (2nd class+) or IFLA equivalent; closely related fields need evidence of Level 6 landscape knowledge.
  • Portfolio: online up to ~12 pages; non-art backgrounds may use research summaries and annotated observation drawings.
  • English: IELTS 6.5 with subscores ≥5.5 (Part 1/conversion) or ≥6.0 (direct Part 2).

Fees, timing and accreditation?

  • Fees: 2027 unset; 2026 reference £12,400 UK / £28,500 international per year (MMU). Extra material costs listed on the course page. Possible £3,000 year-one international scholarship (automatic consideration).
  • Apply: 2027/28 master’s applications open 10 Oct 2026; check the course page for any closing date. Read MSA portfolio guidance first.
  • Accreditation: full Landscape Institute review in progress; not guaranteed—monitor the page.
  • Compare: CUHK MLA, CUHK SUP.

How should converters build a landscape portfolio?

Author's advice (not official): MSA looks for aptitude, not polished art pieces. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, architecture converters who submit only building drawings underperform; stronger sets add place-reading, planting/hydrology observation and one or two community-scale projects, then explain in interview why landscape—not architecture—is the next tool.

Sources: UoM MLA 2027, MSA MLA, MSA Apply, How to apply (October 2026).

title.zh-Hant: NUS 都市設計碩士 MAUD 怎麼申請？2027 截止日、學費 4.9 萬新幣、作品集與雅思（2026 年 10 月官網查核）
title.en: How do you apply to NUS MA Urban Design (MAUD)? 2027 deadline, S$49,050 tuition, portfolio and IELTS (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: NUS MAUD：全日制一年都市設計碩士；2027/8 入學申請至 2027/2/28；國際生學費 S$49,050；IELTS 6.5／TOEFL 92；作品集≤20 頁。
summary.en: NUS MAUD: one-year urban design master’s; Aug 2027 applications through 28 Feb 2027; international fee S$49,050; IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 92; portfolio ≤20 pages.

tldr.zh-Hant: NUS MAUD：1 年全日制／2 年兼讀；申請 2026/10/1–2027/2/28（建議 11/30 前）；國際生 S$49,050；公民／PR／校友 S$29,430；IELTS 6.5 或 TOEFL 92；作品集 PDF≤20 頁 A4、上傳≤10MB；申請費 S$163.50。
tldr.en: NUS MAUD: 1-yr FT / 2-yr PT; apply 1 Oct 2026–28 Feb 2027 (aim 30 Nov); intl S$49,050; Citizens/PRs/alumni S$29,430; IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 92; portfolio ≤20 A4 pages, ≤10 MB uploads; application fee S$163.50.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：新加坡國立大學（NUS）設計與工程學院建築系的 Master of Arts in Urban Design（MAUD）是亞洲較早設立的都市設計授課碩士之一（自 1998），全日制一年（兼讀兩年）。2027 年 8 月入學申請窗為 2026 年 10 月 1 日–2027 年 2 月 28 日；建議爭取 2026 年 11 月 30 日前送件以利提早審理。國際生全程學費（AY2026/27 起適用、含 GST）S$49,050；新加坡公民／PR／NUS 校友為 S$29,430。英文：IELTS 6.5 或 TOEFL iBT 92（測驗中心或 Home Edition）。須交作品集（PDF≤20 頁 A4、系統總上傳≤10MB）、CV、≤1000 字動機、兩封推薦信；短名單可能面試。

以下於 2026 年 10 月對照 MAUD 簡介、招生、學費頁查核；學費每年檢討。

文首封面是 NUS SDE4（設計與環境學院相關建築）外觀，無人物。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（File: NUS SDE4, February 2020.jpg）

MAUD 學什麼？為何強調亞洲高密度？

官網指出課程圍繞：高密度都市環境的物質與社會條件、科技與資料輔助設計、社會參與與社區、系統思考與跨專業協作。一年全日制以兩個都市設計工作室為核心，搭配理論、方法與科技課，並可參與海外田野、實習與研究。

  • 學制：全日制 1 年／兼讀 2 年。
  • 定位：以新加坡與亞洲城市為實驗室，訓練具備策略視野的都市設計師。

申請條件、作品集與英文？

  • 學歷：建築／城鄉規劃／景觀／環境設計等設計向建成環境學士以上；或房地產、交通規劃、項目管理、人文地理等相關學科。相關實務經驗加分。
  • 作品集：PDF、最多 20 頁 A4；每個項目須標註時段、性質、合作者與指導者／雇主；組件／職業作品須寫清個人貢獻。系統全部上傳≤10MB。
  • 其他：成績單、≤2 頁 CV、≤1000 字 Statement of Purpose、兩封推薦信；可能視訊面試。
  • 英文：IELTS 總分 6.5 或 TOEFL iBT 92；英語國家英語授課學位可豁免（官網示例含新加坡、香港、英美澳等）。
  • 申請費：S$163.50（含 GST，不可退）。

學費、時程與誰適合？

  • 學費（AY2026/27 起）：國際生全程 S$49,050；公民／PR／校友 S$29,430（含接受錄取費結構，詳見學費頁）。費用含 9% GST，每年可能調整。
  • 時程：2026/10/1–2027/2/28；11/30 前送件利於提早審理；多數通知約 2027 年 3 月前後。
  • 適合：想以亞洲高密度城市為訓練場的建築／規劃／景觀背景者。若比較港校城市向，可看 中大 Urban Design、科大 DISC、中大可持續城市規劃。

都市設計作品集，怎樣才算「可協作」？

作者建議（非官方要求）：MAUD 官網把協作與系統思考寫進課程核心，作品集除了最終總圖，更要讓人看出你如何與其他專業對接。在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，只交漂亮軸測的申請者偏弱；更好的是一至兩個高密度場所項目，能標清你的貢獻、資料來源與若要落地還缺哪些規劃／工程介面。

官方來源：MAUD 簡介、招生頁、學費頁、CDE 授課碩士申請（2026 年 10 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: NUS College of Design and Engineering’s Master of Arts in Urban Design (MAUD) is a taught urban-design master’s (founded 1998), one year full-time (two years part-time). For the August 2027 intake, applications run 1 October 2026–28 February 2027; submit by 30 November 2026 for early consideration. International full programme fee from AY2026/27 is S$49,050 (incl. GST); Singapore Citizens/PRs/NUS alumni pay S$29,430. English: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 92. Required: portfolio (PDF ≤20 A4 pages; uploads ≤10 MB total), CV, ≤1000-word statement, two references; shortlisted applicants may be interviewed.

Checked October 2026 against the MAUD overview, admissions and fee pages. Fees are reviewed yearly.

Cover: exterior of NUS SDE4 with no people. Image source: Wikimedia Commons (File: NUS SDE4, February 2020.jpg)

What does MAUD teach, and why Asia’s high density?

The programme is organised around high-density urban environments, technology/data-augmented design, community engagement and systems thinking/collaboration. The one-year full-time curriculum is anchored by two urban design studios plus theory, methods and technology courses, with optional field trips, internships and research.

  • Mode: 1 year full-time / 2 years part-time.
  • Positioning: Singapore and Asian cities as laboratories for urban-design innovation.

Entry, portfolio and English?

  • Degree: bachelor’s+ in design-based built-environment fields, or related disciplines (e.g. real estate, transport planning, project management, human geography). Relevant experience helps.
  • Portfolio: PDF, ≤20 A4 pages; declare period, nature, collaborators and instructors/employers per project; state your contribution for group/professional work. Total uploads ≤10 MB.
  • Other: transcripts, ≤2-page CV, ≤1000-word statement, two references; possible video interview.
  • English: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 92; English-medium degrees in listed English-speaking settings may be waived.
  • Application fee: S$163.50 (incl. GST, non-refundable).

Fees, timing and fit?

  • Fees (from AY2026/27): international S$49,050; Citizens/PRs/alumni S$29,430 (see fee page for acceptance-fee structure). Inclusive of 9% GST; subject to yearly review.
  • Timing: 1 Oct 2026–28 Feb 2027; aim for 30 Nov 2026; many offers around March 2027.
  • Fit: architecture/planning/landscape applicants targeting high-density Asian urbanism. Compare CUHK Urban Design, HKUST DISC, CUHK SUP.

What makes an urban-design portfolio look collaborative?

Author's advice (not official): MAUD embeds collaboration and systems thinking; portfolios should show how you interface with other professions, not only final axonometrics. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, render-only sets underperform; stronger applications use one or two high-density place projects with clear contribution, data sources and missing planning/engineering interfaces.

Sources: MAUD overview, admissions, fees, CDE coursework application (October 2026).

title.en: How do you apply to HKU BASc(Design+)? JS6236, 20 places, portfolio and 2027 deadlines (checked October 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 港大 BASc(Design+)：四年 240 學分、Design+ 主修 96；首年名額 20；作品集 PDF≤10MB；非聯招首輪 2026/11/25；本地學費約 HK$49,500、建築學院非本地 HK$250,000。

tldr.zh-Hant: JS6236；四年／240 學分（Design+ 主修 96＋第二主修或雙副修）；首年 20 人；JUPAS 英文 Level 5（課程頁）；作品集 PDF≤10MB（非聯招 11/25 中午、JUPAS 12/2 前）；非聯招首輪 2026/11/25 中午、關閉 2027/8/25 中午；JUPAS 申請 12/2 17:00；申請費 HK$780；本地資助學費 HK$49,500、建築學院非本地 HK$250,000／年（2027/28）。
tldr.en: JS6236; 4 years / 240 credits (96-credit Design+ major + second major or two minors); 20 first-year places; HKDSE English Level 5 (programme page); portfolio PDF ≤10 MB (non-JUPAS noon 25 Nov; JUPAS by 2 Dec); non-JUPAS first round noon 25 Nov 2026, close noon 25 Aug 2027; JUPAS application 17:00 2 Dec; application fee HK$780; local subsidised HK$49,500; Architecture non-local HK$250,000/yr (2027/28).

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：香港大學建築學院的 Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Design+（BASc(Design+)、JUPAS JS6236）是四年制跨學科設計思維本科，總學分 240，其中 Design+ 主修 96，並須修第二主修或兩個副修。官網與 JUPAS 皆標示首年名額 20。申請須交創意作品集（PDF≤10MB）：非聯招／國際生 2026 年 11 月 25 日中午前、JUPAS 2026 年 12 月 2 日前（官網未寫 noon）；短名單面試。非聯招首輪評審截止 2026/11/25 中午，系統關閉 2027/8/25 中午；申請費 HK$780（不可退）。2027/28 學年：本地合資格資助學費 HK$49,500／年；建築學院屬 Non-STEM，非本地／不合資格本地 HK$250,000／年。

以下於 2026 年 10–11 月對照建築學院 Design+ 簡介與招生頁、JUPAS JS6236、港大本科學費與申請費頁查核；學費與截止日每年可能調整。

文首封面是港大鈕魯詩樓（Knowles Building，建築學院所在）室內空間，無人物。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（File: HKU University of Hong Kong Pok Fu Lam campus Knowles Building August 2021 SS2 18.jpg）

Design+ 學什麼？240 學分怎麼拆？

課程以設計思維為跨學科基礎，訓練學生整合分析與想像、領導跨領域項目團隊。課程結構（官網課程表）大致為：

  • Design+ 主修 96 學分：含 Ideas、Representation、當代設計議題、材料科學與工程、資料與跨域創新、創新研究、法律／創新／科技／創業、跨域流程與應用，以及五個 Design+ Studio（Studio 1–2 各 6；Studio 3–5 各 12，含 Capstone）。
  • BASc 核心 18 學分、選修小計 90（第二主修或雙副修 72–84＋自由選修 6–18）、大學共同核心與語文 36；總計 240。
  • 學制：四年全日制；首年名額 20（UGC 資助）。

申請條件、英文、作品集與面試？

  • JUPAS（課程招生頁）：須符合大學一般入學要求，且 HKDSE 英文達 Level 5 或同等；以 Category A／C 最佳五科（可含 M1／M2）計分。JUPAS 資訊頁另列科目最低門檻（含英文 Level 4 等），但課程官方招生頁要求英文 Level 5——申請時以建築學院招生頁為準。
  • 非聯招／國際生：依大學一般入學要求，按個別 merit 審核。
  • 作品集：至少一件創意作品（美術、寫作或其他創意產出）；PDF、≤10MB、毋須紙本；非聯招 2026/11/25 中午、JUPAS 2026/12/2 前（官網未寫 noon）交至學院；短名單面試。
  • 面試時程（課程招生頁）：非聯招約 2027 年 1 月下旬及 3–7 月；JUPAS 約 2027 年 6 月中／7 月下旬（通常僅 Band A）。
  • 申請費：2027 入學非聯招／國際本科申請費 HK$780（不可退）。

學費、獎學金與誰適合？

  • 學費（2027/28）：本地合資格資助 HK$49,500／年；建築學院屬 Non-STEM 院系，非本地及不合資格本地 HK$250,000／年。生活費與宿舍另計（官網學費頁有區間說明）。
  • F.L.Y. Scholarship：面向 BASc 一年級優秀生，含師徒／培訓／實習，並設創新基金 HK$20,000（詳見港大 F.L.Y. 獎學金頁；條款可能按入學年更新，2027 入學請以當季頁為準）。
  • 時程提醒：非聯招首輪 2026/11/25 中午；之後滾動至 2027/8/25 中午。JUPAS 申請截止 2026/12/2 17:00；JUPAS 作品集 12/2 前（官網未寫 noon）。
  • 適合：想以設計思維做跨學科創新、並願意同時修讀第二主修／雙副修的申請者。若比較港校設計／建築本科匯總，可看 香港設計與建築本科 2027；城市向碩士可對照 科大 DISC、NUS MAUD。

跨學科作品集，怎樣才算「能帶隊」？

作者建議（非官方要求）：Design+ 官網強調領導跨領域項目、把多學科知識合成可執行方案。在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，只堆風格化視覺、卻說不清問題界定與協作角色的申請者偏弱；更好的是一至兩件能標註個人貢獻、資料來源與若落地還缺哪些專業介面的創意／設計思維項目。

官方來源：Design+ 簡介與課程結構、招生頁、JUPAS JS6236、學費、申請費、F.L.Y. 獎學金（2026 年 10–11 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: HKU Faculty of Architecture’s Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Design+ (BASc(Design+), JUPAS JS6236) is a four-year interdisciplinary design-thinking undergraduate degree totalling 240 credits, including a 96-credit Design+ major plus a second major or two minors. Official pages list 20 first-year places. Applicants must submit a creative portfolio (PDF ≤10 MB) by noon 25 November 2026 (non-JUPAS) or by 2 December 2026 (JUPAS; site does not say noon); shortlisted candidates are interviewed. Non-JUPAS first-round evaluation closes noon 25 November 2026; applications close noon 25 August 2027. Application fee HK$780 (non-refundable). For 2027/28: local subsidised tuition HK$49,500/year; Architecture is Non-STEM, so non-local / non-eligible local pay HK$250,000/year.

Checked October–November 2026 against the Faculty Design+ overview and admissions pages, JUPAS JS6236, and HKU undergraduate fee / application-fee pages. Fees and deadlines can change yearly.

Cover: interior of HKU Knowles Building (Faculty of Architecture) with no people. Image source: Wikimedia Commons (File: HKU University of Hong Kong Pok Fu Lam campus Knowles Building August 2021 SS2 18.jpg)

What does Design+ teach, and how do 240 credits break down?

The curriculum centres design thinking as a foundation for interdisciplinary study, innovation and enterprise, training graduates to lead multi-disciplinary project teams. Official structure:

  • Design+ major (96 credits): Ideas; Representation; Contemporary issues in design; Material science and engineering; Data for interdisciplinary innovation; Research for innovation; Law, innovation, technology and entrepreneurship; Interdisciplinary processes and applications; plus five Design+ Studios (Studios 1–2 at 6 credits each; Studios 3–5 at 12 each, including Capstone).
  • BASc core 18 credits, electives sub-total 90 (second major or two minors 72–84 + free electives 6–18), university Common Core and languages 36; grand total 240.
  • Mode: four years full-time; first-year intake 20 (UGC-funded).

Entry, English, portfolio and interviews?

  • JUPAS (programme admissions page): meet University entrance requirements and HKDSE English Level 5 or equivalent; scoring uses best five Category A/C subjects (may include M1/M2). The JUPAS programme table also lists subject minima (including English Level 4); the Faculty admissions page requires English Level 5—follow the Faculty page when preparing.
  • Non-JUPAS / international: University entrance requirements plus individual merit.
  • Portfolio: at least one creative work (fine art, writing or other creative output); PDF ≤10 MB; no hard copy; due noon 25 Nov 2026 (non-JUPAS) or by 2 Dec 2026 (JUPAS; site does not say noon); shortlisted candidates interview.
  • Interview windows (programme page): non-JUPAS late January 2027 and March–July 2027; JUPAS mid-June and late July 2027 (normally Band A).
  • Application fee: HK$780 for 2027 undergraduate non-JUPAS / international intake (non-refundable).

Fees, scholarship and fit?

  • Tuition (2027/28): local subsidised HK$49,500/year; Architecture is listed under Non-STEM faculties, so non-local and non-eligible local students pay HK$250,000/year. Living costs and housing are separate (see fee page ranges).
  • F.L.Y. Scholarship: for outstanding first-year BASc students—mentorship, training, internships, plus an innovation fund of HK$20,000 (see F.L.Y. page; terms may change by intake year—confirm the current page for 2027 entry).
  • Timing: non-JUPAS first round noon 25 Nov 2026; rolling until noon 25 Aug 2027. JUPAS application deadline 17:00 on 2 Dec 2026; JUPAS portfolio by 2 Dec (site does not say noon).
  • Fit: applicants who want design thinking across disciplines and will take a second major or two minors. Compare the Hong Kong design/architecture undergraduate round-up HK design & architecture UG 2027; for urban master’s paths see HKUST DISC and NUS MAUD.

What makes an interdisciplinary portfolio look leadership-ready?

Author's advice (not official): Design+ stresses leading multi-disciplinary project teams and synthesising knowledge into actionable plans. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, style-only sets that never define the problem or your role underperform; stronger applications show one or two creative / design-thinking projects with clear contribution, sources and missing professional interfaces.

Sources: Design+ overview, admissions, JUPAS JS6236, fees, application fee, F.L.Y. scholarship (October–November 2026).

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：香港大學建築學系的 Bachelor of Arts in Architectural Studies（BA(AS)、JUPAS JS6004）是四年全日制建築學文學士，也是通往註冊建築師路徑的第一學位。JUPAS 標示首年名額 54；須交創意作品集（PDF、最多 5 頁 A4 直式）。非聯招／國際生首輪評審截止 2026 年 11 月 25 日中午；JUPAS 截止 2026 年 12 月 2 日 17:00。作品集邀請信約於非聯招 11 月下旬、JUPAS 12 月中旬寄出，經 BA(AS) 提交系統上傳。短名單面試：非聯招約 2026 年 12 月初起，JUPAS 約 2027 年 6 月中。申請費 HK$780；2027/28 本地合資格資助學費 HK$49,500／年，建築學院屬 Non-STEM，非本地／不合資格本地 HK$250,000／年。不要求推薦信；內地高考申請者不適用上述作品集補充要求。

以下於 2026 年 10–11 月對照建築學系 BA(AS) 簡介與招生頁、JUPAS JS6004、港大學費與申請費頁查核；時程與學費每年可能調整。

文首封面是鈕魯詩樓（Knowles Building）夜間／室內詢問處，無人物。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（File: HKU 香港大學 Night Campus 紐魯斯樓 Knowles Building Lift lobby Aug-2009.JPG；Commons 檔名作「紐魯斯樓」，正文統一「鈕魯詩樓」）

BA(AS) 學什麼？專業認可是什麼？

官網指出課程以設計工作室為核心，涵蓋建築設計、歷史與理論、技術與視覺傳達，並以香港與東亞高密度城市為學習場域。畢業取得成為建築師所需的第一學位；課程獲 HKIA、香港建築師註冊管理局認可，並經 RIBA 驗證，亦透過 Canberra Accord 與多國建築認證體系具實質等同性。完成建築碩士並通過 HKIA／ARB 專業評核後，可申請成為 HKIA 會員及註冊建築師。

  • 學制：四年全日制；JUPAS 首年名額 54（UGC 資助）。
  • 國際交流：與歐美亞多校設有交換（官網列舉含 ETH Zurich、UCL、UC Berkeley、清華、同濟、NUS 等）。

申請條件、作品集與面試？

  • 入學：符合大學一般入學要求；文理背景皆歡迎。評分以 Category A（可含 M1／M2 或 Category C）最佳科目組合計算（詳見 hku.hk/dse）。
  • 作品集：PDF、最多 5 頁 A4 直式；展現空間與社會思考、構想／創造／分析能力；可含素描、繪畫、雕塑、模型、攝影等既有作品。細節與登入資料以電郵通知後，經 BA(AS) Submission System 上傳。
  • 時程：非聯招首輪 2026/11/25 中午；JUPAS 2026/12/2 17:00。作品集邀請：非聯招約 11 月下旬、JUPAS 約 12 月中旬。面試：非聯招約 2026 年 12 月初（另有 2027 年 3–7 月補邀）；JUPAS 約 2027 年 6 月中（另有 7 月下旬補邀）。
  • 推薦信：不要求。
  • 高考：參加內地全國統一高考者，不適用上述作品集補充要求（依內地招生頁）。
  • 申請費：2027 入學非聯招／國際本科 HK$780（不可退）。

學費、誰適合，以及作品集怎麼讓 thinking→making 被看見？

  • 學費（2027/28）：本地合資格資助 HK$49,500／年；建築學院 Non-STEM，非本地／不合資格本地 HK$250,000／年。
  • 適合：想以建築作為文化學科、願意用少量頁面講清空間與社會論點的申請者。同校跨學科設計可看 港大 Design+；港校本科匯總見 香港設計與建築本科 2027。

作者建議（非官方要求）：招生頁把作品集定義為展示 architectural thinking、drawing and making，並點名 spatial and social。在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，五頁內只堆效果圖卻說不清問題與個人操作的申請者偏弱；更好的是一至兩個項目，能讓人順著 thinking→drawing／making 的鏈條看見你的判斷。

註：大學 Registry 面試總表對 BA(AS) 的時窗較粗（作品集約 early-December 2026、面試 Mid-December 2026 to February 2027）；本文面試細窗以建築學院招生頁為準（非聯招 Early-December／JUPAS Mid-June 等）。

官方來源：BA(AS) 簡介、招生頁、JUPAS JS6004、學費、申請費（2026 年 10–11 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: HKU Department of Architecture’s Bachelor of Arts in Architectural Studies (BA(AS), JUPAS JS6004) is a four-year full-time first professional undergraduate degree in architecture. JUPAS lists 54 first-year places. Applicants must submit a creative portfolio (PDF, max 5 A4 portrait pages). Non-JUPAS / international first-round evaluation closes noon 25 November 2026; JUPAS closes 17:00 on 2 December 2026. Portfolio invitations are emailed around late November (non-JUPAS) / mid-December (JUPAS) for upload via the BA(AS) Submission System. Shortlisted interviews: early December 2026 (non-JUPAS) and mid-June 2027 (JUPAS), with later makeup windows. Application fee HK$780. For 2027/28: local subsidised tuition HK$49,500/year; Architecture is Non-STEM, so non-local / non-eligible local pay HK$250,000/year. Recommendation letters are not required; Mainland Gaokao applicants are not subject to these portfolio supplements.

Checked October–November 2026 against the BA(AS) overview and admissions pages, JUPAS JS6004, and HKU fee / application-fee pages. Dates and fees can change yearly.

Cover: Knowles Building (鈕魯詩樓) enquiry lobby with no people. Image source: Wikimedia Commons (File: HKU Night Campus Knowles Building Lift lobby Aug-2009.JPG; Commons Chinese filename uses 紐魯斯樓; this post standardises on 鈕魯詩樓)

What does BA(AS) teach, and what accreditation does it carry?

The curriculum centres design studios and covers architectural design, history and theory, technology and visual communication, using Hong Kong and East Asian high-density cities as a laboratory. Graduates earn the first degree needed to qualify as an architect. The programme is accredited by HKIA and the HKSAR Architects Registration Board, validated by RIBA, and recognised via the Canberra Accord. After an MArch and passing the HKIA/ARB Professional Assessment, graduates may seek HKIA membership and registration as architects.

  • Mode: four years full-time; JUPAS first-year intake 54 (UGC-funded).
  • Exchange: partners listed on the programme page include ETH Zurich, UCL, UC Berkeley, Tsinghua, Tongji, NUS and others.

Entry, portfolio and interviews?

  • Entry: University general entrance requirements; arts and science streams welcome. Scoring uses best Category A subjects (may include M1/M2 or Category C); see hku.hk/dse.
  • Portfolio: PDF, ≤5 A4 portrait pages; show spatial and social thinking and the ability to conceptualize, create and analyse; prior drawings, models, photography, etc. are fine. After the email invitation, upload via the BA(AS) Submission System.
  • Timing: non-JUPAS first round noon 25 Nov 2026; JUPAS 17:00 on 2 Dec 2026. Portfolio invites: late Nov (non-JUPAS) / mid-Dec (JUPAS). Interviews: early Dec 2026 (non-JUPAS; makeup Mar–Jul 2027) and mid-Jun 2027 (JUPAS; makeup late Jul).
  • Recommendations: not required.
  • Gaokao: NJCEE applicants are not subject to these portfolio supplements (see Mainland admissions).
  • Application fee: HK$780 for 2027 non-JUPAS / international undergraduate intake (non-refundable).

Fees, fit, and making thinking→making readable?

  • Tuition (2027/28): local subsidised HK$49,500/year; Architecture Non-STEM non-local / non-eligible local HK$250,000/year.
  • Fit: applicants who treat architecture as a cultural discipline and can argue spatial and social ideas in few pages. Compare HKU Design+ and the Hong Kong design & architecture UG 2027 round-up.

Author's advice (not official): the admissions page frames the portfolio as architectural thinking, drawing and making, plus spatial and social reasoning. Across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, five-page render-only sets underperform; stronger applications let readers follow a thinking→drawing/making chain in one or two projects.

Note: the University Registry interview table lists a coarser BA(AS) window (portfolio by early-December 2026; interviews mid-December 2026 to February 2027). Fine-grained interview windows in this article follow the Faculty admissions page (early December non-JUPAS / mid-June JUPAS, plus makeup windows).

Sources: BA(AS) overview, admissions, JUPAS JS6004, fees, application fee (October–November 2026).

summary.en: UCL MSc HCI: taught by UCLIC, 1 year full-time; apply 19 Oct 2026 – 12 Feb 2027; 2027/28 fees £44,400 international, £16,800 UK; upper second + IELTS 7.5 (7.0 each); £90 fee, one reference.

tldr.zh-Hant: UCLIC 授課；全日制 1 年／兼讀 2 年；2027 年 9 月入學；申請 2026/10/19–2027/2/12 英國時間 17:00；2027/28 國際 £44,400、英國 £16,800；CS／心理／人因或相關（介面設計、產品設計等）二等一；英語 Level 4＝雅思 7.5（各項 7.0）；申請費 £90；推薦 1 封；課程頁未列作品集；目標 5 月中前出結果。
tldr.en: Taught by UCLIC; 1 year full-time / 2 years part-time; starts September 2027; apply 19 Oct 2026 – 12 Feb 2027, 5pm UK; 2027/28 fees £44,400 international, £16,800 UK; upper second in CS, psychology, ergonomics or related (interface design, product design, etc.); English Level 4 = IELTS 7.5 (7.0 each); £90 fee; one reference; no portfolio listed on the programme page; decisions by mid-May.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦大學學院（UCL）的 Human-Computer Interaction MSc（人機互動碩士）由 UCL Interaction Centre（UCLIC）授課、隸屬 Division of Psychology and Language Sciences，校區在倫敦 Bloomsbury。全日制 1 年（另有 2 年兼讀、最長 5 年彈性模組制），2027 年 9 月入學。申請期 2026 年 10 月 19 日至 2027 年 2 月 12 日（英國時間下午 5 點）；2027/28 全日制學費 國際生 £44,400、英國學生 £16,800。學術門檻是電腦科學、心理學、人因工程或相關領域（如介面設計、商業 IT、產品設計）英國二等一（upper second-class）以上；英語為 UCL Level 4（雅思總分 7.5、各項 7.0）。申請費 £90、推薦人 1 位；官方表示截止後統一審核、目標最晚 5 月中發出結果。

以下於 2026 年 11 月對照 UCL 課程頁與英語要求頁查核；學費、時程與模組每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。

文首封面是 Wilkins Building 柱廊在 UCL Illuminated 燈光投影活動中的夜景，無可辨識人物。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（UCL Main Building - UCL Illuminated，Daniel Cooper，CC BY-SA 4.0，裁切）

UCL MSc HCI 學什麼？跟設計類 UX 碩士差在哪？

官網定位：HCI 關注電腦與行動科技的設計與使用，聚焦人與系統之間的介面；課程位在工程、行為科學與設計的交叉點，兼顧學術嚴謹與業界看重的實務技能。學生要學會把人的生理、認知、社會與情感知識用在互動系統設計上，並分析、測試使用者表現、偏好與體驗。與藝術學院的 UX／互動設計 MA 相比，這裡更偏研究方法、實驗與評估，最後以個人研究項目畢業。

  • Term 1：必修 Interaction Design（PSYC0097）與 Interaction Science（PSYC0101），為研究項目打底。
  • Term 2：依 UCLIC 教師研究領域選修，並選定研究題目。
  • Term 3（含暑期）：個人研究項目 MSc HCI Project（PSYC0103），暑期最多約 12 小時指導。
  • 官網列出的選修（示意，可能變動）：Affective Interaction、Future Interfaces、Game Design for Mental Health、Disability Interaction、User-Centred Data Visualization、The Digital Workplace、Human-AI Interaction、HCI for Health and Wellbeing。

上課多重？怎麼評分？

  • 時數：全日制估計每週 36–44 小時投入；Term 1、2 每週授課接觸 12–16 小時，自學 24–28 小時。兼讀每週約 18–25 小時。
  • 評量：課業與考試並行；課業含設計作品集（design portfolios）、簡報、影片、反思報告與學術論文；一門必修與部分選修有小組評量；畢業項目以書面論文報告評分。
  • 學術發表：官網提到許多過往研究項目曾在國際頂尖會議發表；課程模組鼓勵投稿時，成功者通常可獲最多 £500 會議補助（其餘自付，且非強制）。
  • 業界連結：每週業界講者系列、參訪顧問公司與現場；UCLIC 及其前身 UCL Ergonomics Unit 在此領域培訓超過 30 年。

申請條件是什麼？要作品集嗎？

  • 學歷：電腦科學、心理學或人因工程，或其相關領域（如介面設計、商業 IT、產品設計）二等一以上學位；相關實務或工作經驗會納入考量。官網提醒須特別留意個人陳述的撰寫指引。
  • 英語：Level 4＝IELTS Academic 總分 7.5、各項不低於 7.0（UCL 首選考試）。TOEFL iBT 依考試日期：2026 年 1 月 21 日起之成績須總分 5.5、各項 5.0；之前的成績為總分 109（閱讀、寫作各 27，口說、聽力各 23）。
  • 推薦信：1 封，須在截止日後兩週內送達。
  • 作品集：2026 年 11 月查核時，課程頁申請說明未把作品集列為申請材料；重點在個人陳述。若你有 UX／研究案例，可在陳述中說清方法與結果（作者建議，非官方要求）。
  • 申請數量：同一申請週期最多申請兩個研究所課程。

個人陳述要回答哪四個問題？

官網列出審查想了解的四點：①為何想在研究所階段讀 HCI；②UCL 這門課的哪些課程內容吸引你；③你的學術與專業背景如何應付這門高強度課程；④畢業後想往業界或學術哪裡走。若使用生成式 AI 協助草擬，須在文末註明工具名稱、版本、發行者，並用一兩句說明用法。

2027 入學時程、學費與押金？

  • 申請期：2026/10/19–2027/2/12，英國時間下午 5 點截止；官方表示截止後一併審核所有完整且達最低門檻的申請，目標最晚 5 月中發出結果；未達門檻者可能在截止前即被拒。
  • 學費（2027/28）：全日制英國 £16,800／國際 £44,400；兼讀每年 £8,400／£22,200。多數授課型碩士適用 cohort guarantee（就讀期間學費不調升，另有官方但書）。
  • 申請費：線上申請 £90。
  • 錄取押金：海外學費身分為首年學費 10%（全日制約 £4,440），英國身分 2.5%；彈性模組制海外 £500、英國 £350。

畢業出路如何？適合誰？

官網引用 HESA Graduate Outcomes 2023–2024：90% HCI 畢業生在結業 15 個月內從事全職高技能工作或繼續深造；去向含 IT 與科技電信、顧問、醫療與社會照護、金融服務、政策與政府。課程適合心理學、電腦科學或相近背景、想在業界、學術或顧問環境從事 HCI 的人。想比較美國同類項目，可看 CMU MHCI、Georgia Tech MS-HCI、UW MHCI+D 與 UMich MSI。

作者建議（非官方要求）：在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，轉申 HCI 的設計背景學生最常吃虧的是「只有好看的介面、沒有研究與驗證」。UCL 的必修是 Interaction Design 加 Interaction Science，畢業靠研究項目；陳述裡至少放一個你如何定義問題、找使用者測試、用數據修改設計的完整例子，比堆疊工具清單更有說服力。

官方來源：UCL Human-Computer Interaction MSc 課程頁、UCL 研究所英語要求（2026 年 11 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: UCL’s Human-Computer Interaction MSc is taught by the UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC) within the Division of Psychology and Language Sciences, on the Bloomsbury campus in London. Full-time study takes 1 calendar year (part-time 2 years; flexible/modular up to 5 years), starting September 2027. Applications run from 19 October 2026 to 12 February 2027 (5pm UK time). 2027/28 full-time fees are £44,400 for international students and £16,800 for UK students. You need at least an upper second-class degree in computer science, psychology or ergonomics, or a related field (e.g. interface design, business IT, product design), and UCL English Level 4 (IELTS 7.5 overall, 7.0 in each component). The application fee is £90 and one reference is required; UCL reviews applications together after the deadline and aims to return decisions no later than mid-May.

Checked against UCL’s programme page and English language requirements page in November 2026; fees, dates and modules can change each year, so re-check before you apply.

The cover shows the Wilkins Building portico lit by projections during UCL Illuminated, with no identifiable people. Image: Wikimedia Commons (UCL Main Building - UCL Illuminated, Daniel Cooper, CC BY-SA 4.0, cropped)

What does the UCL HCI MSc teach, and how is it different from design-school UX master’s?

UCL describes HCI as the design and use of computer and mobile technology, focusing on the interfaces between people and systems. The course sits at the intersection of engineering, behavioural sciences and design, combining academic rigour with practical skills employers value. Students learn to apply physical, cognitive, social and affective knowledge to interactive-system design and to analyse and test user performance, preferences and experience. Compared with art-school UX or interaction design MAs, it leans more towards research methods, experiments and evaluation, and finishes with an individual research project.

  • Term 1: compulsory Interaction Design (PSYC0097) and Interaction Science (PSYC0101), laying foundations for the research project.
  • Term 2: optional modules built around UCLIC staff research areas, plus choosing a project.
  • Term 3 (and summer): the individual MSc HCI Project (PSYC0103), with up to about 12 hours of supervision over the summer.
  • Optional modules listed (indicative, subject to change): Affective Interaction, Future Interfaces, Game Design for Mental Health, Disability Interaction, User-Centred Data Visualization, The Digital Workplace, Human-AI Interaction, HCI for Health and Wellbeing.

How heavy is the workload, and how are you assessed?

  • Hours: full-time students are estimated to spend 36–44 hours a week; contact hours are 12–16 a week in Terms 1 and 2, with 24–28 hours of independent study. Part-time is about 18–25 hours a week.
  • Assessment: coursework and exams; coursework includes design portfolios, presentations, videos, reflective reports and academic essays; one compulsory module and some optional modules have assessed group work; the final project is assessed by a written dissertation report.
  • Publishing: UCL notes many past projects have been presented at leading international conferences; where module work is accepted, students normally receive up to £500 towards conference costs (attendance is optional and any extra cost is yours).
  • Industry links: a weekly industry speaker series and visits to consultancies and field sites; UCLIC and the earlier UCL Ergonomics Unit have trained people in this field for over 30 years.

What are the entry requirements? Do you need a portfolio?

  • Degree: an upper second-class degree in computer science, psychology or ergonomics, or a related field (e.g. interface design, business IT, product design); relevant practical or work experience is taken into account. UCL asks applicants to follow the personal statement instructions carefully.
  • English: Level 4 = IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each component (UCL’s preferred test). TOEFL iBT depends on the test date: tests from 21 January 2026 need 5.5 overall and 5.0 in each skill; earlier tests need 109 overall (27 in reading and writing, 23 in speaking and listening).
  • References: one, which must arrive within two weeks of the closing date.
  • Portfolio: when checked in November 2026, the programme page’s application guidance did not list a portfolio; the personal statement is the focus. If you have UX or research case studies, explain the method and results in your statement (author’s advice, not an official requirement).
  • Number of applications: a maximum of two graduate courses per application cycle.

Which four questions should the personal statement answer?

UCL lists four things it wants to learn: (1) why you want to study HCI at graduate level; (2) what attracts you to the specific curriculum of UCL’s HCI MSc; (3) how your academic and professional background meets the demands of this challenging course; (4) where you want to go professionally or academically. If you use generative AI to help draft it, add an acknowledgement at the end naming the tool, version and publisher, with one or two sentences on how you used it.

What are the 2027-entry dates, fees and deposit?

  • Application window: 19 Oct 2026 – 12 Feb 2027, closing 5pm UK time. UCL reviews all complete applications that meet the minimum criteria together after the deadline and aims to return decisions no later than mid-May; applicants below the minimum may be rejected before the deadline.
  • Tuition (2027/28): full-time UK £16,800 / international £44,400; part-time £8,400 / £22,200 per year. Most taught postgraduates benefit from a cohort guarantee (fees do not rise during the course, with UCL’s stated exceptions).
  • Application fee: £90 for online applications.
  • Offer deposit: 10% of the first-year fee for Overseas fee status (about £4,440 full-time) and 2.5% for UK; flexible/modular offer holders pay £500 (Overseas) or £350 (UK).

What are the career outcomes, and who is it for?

Citing the HESA Graduate Outcomes Survey 2023–2024, UCL says 90% of HCI students were in full-time highly skilled work or further study within 15 months of finishing; sectors include IT, technology and telecoms, consultancy, health and social care, financial services, and policy and government. The course suits people with backgrounds in psychology, computer science or a closely related discipline who want HCI roles in industry, academia or consultancy. To compare US options, see CMU MHCI, Georgia Tech MS-HCI, UW MHCI+D and UMich MSI.

Author’s advice (not an official requirement): across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, design-background applicants moving into HCI most often fall short by showing attractive interfaces with no research or validation. UCL’s core is Interaction Design plus Interaction Science, and you graduate through a research project, so include at least one complete example of how you framed a problem, tested with users and used evidence to change the design; that persuades more than a list of tools.

Official sources: UCL Human-Computer Interaction MSc programme page, UCL graduate English language requirements (checked November 2026).

q.zh-Hant: UCL MSc HCI 讀多久？
q.en: How long is the UCL HCI MSc?

a.zh-Hant: 全日制 1 年；兼讀 2 年；彈性模組制最長 5 年；2027 年 9 月入學。
a.en: 1 calendar year full-time, 2 years part-time, up to 5 years flexible/modular; starts September 2027.

q.zh-Hant: 2027 入學申請截止日？
q.en: When is the 2027-entry deadline?

a.zh-Hant: 2027 年 2 月 12 日英國時間下午 5 點（申請期自 2026 年 10 月 19 日起）；目標最晚 5 月中發結果。
a.en: 5pm UK time on 12 February 2027 (applications open 19 October 2026); decisions aimed for no later than mid-May.

q.zh-Hant: 學費多少？
q.en: What are the fees?

a.zh-Hant: 2027/28 全日制國際生 £44,400、英國學生 £16,800；申請費 £90；海外身分錄取押金為首年學費 10%。
a.en: 2027/28 full-time: £44,400 international, £16,800 UK; £90 application fee; Overseas offer deposit is 10% of the first-year fee.

q.zh-Hant: 雅思要幾分？
q.en: What IELTS score is needed?

a.zh-Hant: UCL Level 4：IELTS Academic 總分 7.5、各項 7.0。
a.en: UCL Level 4: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with 7.0 in each component.

q.zh-Hant: 設計背景可以申請嗎？要交作品集嗎？
q.en: Can design graduates apply? Is a portfolio required?

a.zh-Hant: 官網接受相關領域如介面設計、產品設計的二等一學位；查核時課程頁未將作品集列為申請材料，重點是個人陳述與 1 封推薦信。
a.en: Yes, related fields such as interface or product design with an upper second-class degree are accepted; at the time of checking the programme page did not list a portfolio, and the focus is the personal statement plus one reference.

q.zh-Hant: 畢業出路？
q.en: What about careers?

a.zh-Hant: 官網引用 HESA 2023–2024：90% 在結業 15 個月內全職高技能工作或深造。
a.en: UCL cites HESA 2023–2024: 90% in full-time highly skilled work or further study within 15 months.

title.zh-Hant: RCA 服務設計碩士 MA Service Design 怎麼申請？£39,250 學費、2027/1/8 第一輪截止、雅思 6.5 與作品集＋影片要求（2026 年 11 月官網查核）
title.en: How do you apply to the RCA’s MA Service Design? £39,250 fees, 8 Jan 2027 Round 1 deadline, IELTS 6.5, portfolio and video (checked November 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: RCA MA Service Design：1 年 45 週、2027/8 起移至 Kensington；三輪截止 2027/1/8、3/23、6/2；2027 入學海外 £39,250、英國 £15,600；雅思 6.5（各項 5.5）；作品集＋300 字陳述＋2 分鐘影片。
summary.en: RCA MA Service Design: 1 year (45 weeks), moving to Kensington from August 2027; deadlines 8 Jan, 23 Mar and 2 Jun 2027; 2027 fees £39,250 Overseas, £15,600 Home; IELTS 6.5 (5.5 each); portfolio, 300-word statement and two-minute video.

tldr.zh-Hant: School of Communication & Design；180 學分、1 年 45 週全日制；2027 年 9 月入學、2027/8 起在 Kensington 校區；第一輪 2027/1/8、第二輪 3/23、第三輪 6/2（英國時間中午 12 點）；學費海外／歐盟 £39,250、英國 £15,600，押金 £3,500／£1,000；學士或 5 年工作經驗，設計與非設計背景皆可；IELTS 6.5、各項 5.5；作品集 3–5 檔＋300 字陳述＋2 分鐘影片；少數情況面試；滾動錄取。
tldr.en: School of Communication & Design; 180 credits, 1 year (45 weeks) full-time; starts September 2027, at the Kensington campus from August 2027; deadlines 8 Jan, 23 Mar and 2 Jun 2027 (12 noon UK); fees £39,250 Overseas/EU, £15,600 Home, deposits £3,500 / £1,000; a bachelor’s degree or five years’ experience, design or non-design background; IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 in each; 3–5 portfolio files, 300-word statement and two-minute video; interviews only in some cases; rolling offers.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：英國皇家藝術學院（Royal College of Art, RCA）的 Service Design MA（服務設計碩士）屬 School of Communication & Design，180 學分、1 年（45 週）全日制，2027 年 9 月入學。官網寫明本課程 2026/27 在 Battersea 校區上課，2027 年 8 月起移到 Kensington 校區。2027 入學分三輪：第一輪 2027 年 1 月 8 日、第二輪 3 月 23 日、第三輪（碩士最後截止）6 月 2 日，均為英國時間中午 12 點。2027 年 9 月入學學費 海外／歐盟 £39,250、英國本地 £15,600，錄取押金海外 £3,500。申請要交作品集、300 字個人陳述、2 分鐘自我介紹影片；英語為 IELTS 6.5、各項 5.5。設計或非設計背景皆可，需學士學位或至少 5 年工作經驗。

以下於 2026 年 11 月對照 RCA 課程頁、申請日期頁與碩士申請流程頁查核；學費、時程與選修每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。

文首封面是 RCA Kensington 校區 Darwin Building 從 Jay Mews 望去的外觀（無可辨識人物）。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Royal College of Art from Jay Mews，Shadowssettle，CC BY-SA 4.0，裁切）

RCA 服務設計碩士學什麼？跟 UX／互動設計差在哪？

官網把服務設計定位為「跨學科的設計實踐」：不只優化一個介面或一項服務，而是理解人、組織與系統，用同理、信任、系統思考與創意去面對 AI、環境壓力與社會變化帶來的複雜問題。RCA 稱這是全球歷史最悠久的服務設計碩士之一。和偏螢幕介面的 UX／互動設計碩士相比，這裡的成果常是一整套服務、商業模式或公共政策介入，而且以團隊項目為主。

  • Term 1：Service Design Foundation（服務與服務設計理論，小型分析型團隊項目）＋ Service Design Practice（與業界夥伴合作的真實項目，主題如健康、永續、商業創新或社會共融）。
  • Term 2：Service Design in Context（為獨立研究項目寫提案，檢視服務設計對經濟、科技、社會、文化與環境系統的影響）＋跨系所選修（完整選修清單官方表示 2027 年公布）。
  • Term 3：Independent Research Project（IRP，自主研究項目），是本課程對外公開成果的核心，期末有公開活動。
  • 上課方式：工作室制、以團隊做項目，搭配講座與研討；主題包括服務設計的影響與未來、人與數位互動、使用者研究與洞察、設計倫理、整體系統設計、原型與測試。

跟哪些機構合作？畢業去哪？

官網列出近年提供項目題目的機構，例如 Arup、Catch22、Canal Dream CIC、Ealing Council、EY Seren、Red Cross、Tate。畢業生去向包括服務設計、創新、策略與創業，任職於顧問公司、金融服務、政府、設計公司、文化機構、慈善組織，或自行創業。

申請條件是什麼？非設計背景可以嗎？

  • 學歷：BA、BSc 或同等學位，或至少 5 年專業工作經驗。
  • 背景：官網明確表示收「有或沒有設計背景」的學生，看重的是透過作品集展現的特質與創新能力；常見來源包括產品、傳達、數位與 UX 設計，其他設計科系的優秀應屆生，電腦與技術背景，有意以服務為核心創業者，以及業界與公部門的中層與高層專業人士。
  • 英語：非英語為主國家國籍者需 IELTS Academic 或 UKVI 總分 6.5、各項不低於 5.5；總分 6.0 且寫作 5.5 者，可能可透過學校的 English for Academic Purposes 課程補足。近五年在英語為主國家取得二等一以上學位者可豁免。錄取者須在 2027 年 6 月 11 日前上傳英語成績。
  • 面試：只在少數無法單憑書面決定的情況會邀請（線上或到校）；被邀請不代表錄取機率較高或較低。
  • 申請數量：2027 申請年度最多申請 2 個不同課程，同一課程不能重複申請。

作品集要放什麼？影片和個人陳述怎麼準備？

RCA 碩士申請要在 Applicant Portal 上傳 3–5 個作品集檔案、300 字個人陳述、最長 2 分鐘的影片，以及推薦人聯絡方式。服務設計課程頁列出作品集要能看到：

  • 具挑戰性、以改變為目標的項目題目；
  • 來自使用者研究的洞察、好奇心與發掘新洞察的意願；
  • 對人的同理與理解；
  • 超出預期、建立在使用者洞察上的創意；
  • 做出令人想要且有影響力的解決方案的能力；
  • 理解如何落地，概念能否以可持續、可行的方式交付；
  • 能從實體、系統或科技接觸點塑造服務與體驗，並讓使用者覺得美好。

個人陳述（300 字）：介紹自己、興趣與為何申請 RCA 和這個課程；簡述學經歷；說明未來想做什麼。
影片（2 分鐘）：用手機或筆電直接對鏡頭說話即可，不需高製作水準。內容要談：為什麼想成為服務設計師、舉一個你最喜歡的服務體驗、你最熱衷服務設計的哪個面向，以及作品集中最喜歡的項目和原因。

2027 入學三輪截止日與放榜時間？

  • 第一輪：2026/10/12 開放，2027/1/8（週五）英國時間中午 12 點截止，最晚 2027/2/19 通知結果。
  • 第二輪：2027/1/11 開放，2027/3/23（週二）中午 12 點截止，最晚 2027/5/5 通知。
  • 第三輪：2027/3/24 開放，碩士最後截止 2027/6/2（週三）中午 12 點，最晚 2027/7/14 通知。
  • 滾動錄取：官方表示依收件順序審查、滾動發 offer，越早送越早知道結果。收到 offer 後須在 3 週內接受並繳押金。

學費、押金與獎學金多少？

  • 學費（2027 年 9 月入學）：英國本地（補助後）£15,600；海外與歐盟 £39,250（自 2021 年起歐盟生按海外收費）。
  • 押金：英國 £1,000、海外與歐盟 £3,500，不可退，會抵學費。
  • 升讀折扣：RCA Graduate Diploma 校友升讀碩士折 £1,000；RCA 碩士再讀另一碩士折 £2,000。
  • 獎學金：多數須在第一或第二輪申請並取得 offer 後才會受邀申請。以 2026/27 為例，RCA President & Vice-Chancellor’s International 獎學金每名 £9,000（抵學費），第一、二輪申請者自動審核，適用國家／地區包含台灣、香港、新加坡、日本、韓國等；其他獎學金有特定國籍或身分限制。另需預留材料、列印、雷切、3D 列印等額外費用。

這個課程適合誰？怎麼準備比較有勝算？

適合想從「做好一張圖、一個介面」走向「設計整套服務與系統」的人：產品、傳達、UX、建築或室內背景，以及有工作經驗、想轉向創新與策略的專業人士。若你在比較偏研究與實驗的 HCI 路線，可對照 UCL MSc HCI；想看美國互動設計碩士，可參考 康乃爾互動設計類碩士。

作者建議（非官方要求）：在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，轉申服務設計的學生最常見的問題是作品集只有漂亮的最終畫面，看不到「誰是使用者、我訪談或觀察到什麼、因此改了什麼、最後怎麼落地」。RCA 把使用者洞察、可行性與團隊合作寫進評選重點，建議每個項目至少放一張服務藍圖或使用者旅程，並清楚標出你在團隊中的角色；影片則用 2 分鐘講好一個你真心喜歡的服務體驗，比背稿更有說服力。

官方來源：RCA Service Design MA 課程頁、RCA Eligibility and key dates（2027 入學）、RCA Master’s application process（2026 年 11 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the Royal College of Art (RCA) Service Design MA sits in the School of Communication & Design. It is a 180-credit, 1-year (45-week) full-time programme starting September 2027. The RCA says the programme runs at its Battersea campus in 2026/27 and moves to the Kensington campus from August 2027. Applications for 2027 entry have three rounds: 8 January 2027 (Round 1), 23 March 2027 (Round 2) and 2 June 2027 (Round 3, the final Master’s deadline), each at 12 noon UK time. Fees for September 2027 entry are £39,250 for Overseas/EU and £15,600 for Home students, with a £3,500 Overseas deposit. You submit a portfolio, a 300-word personal statement and a two-minute video; English is IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each component. Applicants with or without a design background are welcome; you need a bachelor’s degree or at least five years of professional experience.

Everything below was checked in November 2026 against the RCA programme page, the key-dates page and the Master’s application process page. Fees, dates and electives can change each year, so check the official site before you apply.

The cover shows the RCA Darwin Building on the Kensington campus, seen from Jay Mews (no identifiable people). Image: Wikimedia Commons (Royal College of Art from Jay Mews, Shadowssettle, CC BY-SA 4.0, cropped)

What does the RCA Service Design MA teach, and how is it different from UX or interaction design?

The RCA describes service design as a transdisciplinary practice: it goes beyond improving a single interface or service to understanding people, organisations and systems, using empathy, trust, systems thinking and creativity to tackle complex issues shaped by AI, environmental pressures and social change. The RCA calls it one of the world’s longest-established MA programmes in service design. Compared with screen-focused UX or interaction design master’s degrees, outcomes here are often whole services, business models or public-sector interventions, and the work is mainly team-based.

  • Term 1: Service Design Foundation (theories of service and service design, a small analytical team project) and Service Design Practice (a live project with industry partners on challenges such as health, sustainability, business innovation or social inclusion).
  • Term 2: Service Design in Context (a proposal for your Independent Research Project, examining the impact of service design on economic, technological, social, cultural and environmental systems) plus cross-programme electives (the RCA says the full list will be published in 2027).
  • Term 3: the Independent Research Project (IRP), a self-directed project that forms the core of the programme’s public output, with a public event towards the end.
  • How you learn: studio-based team projects supported by lectures and seminars on the impact and future of service design, human and digital interactions, user research and insight, design ethics, total system design, and prototyping and testing.

Which organisations does it work with, and where do graduates go?

The RCA lists organisations that have set recent project briefs, including Arup, Catch22, Canal Dream CIC, Ealing Council, EY Seren, Red Cross and Tate. Graduates work in service design, innovation, strategy and entrepreneurship, in consultancies, financial services, government, design agencies, cultural institutions and charities, or run their own ventures.

What are the entry requirements? Can non-designers apply?

  • Degree: a BA, BSc or similar, or at least five years of professional experience.
  • Background: the RCA explicitly accepts students with and without a design background who show the right qualities and capacity for creative innovation through their portfolio. Typical applicants come from product, communication, digital and UX design, other design disciplines, computing and technical fields, would-be founders of service-led businesses, and mid- and senior-level professionals from industry and the public sector.
  • English: if you are not a national of a majority English-speaking country, you need IELTS Academic or UKVI 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in every component. Applicants with 6.0 overall and 5.5 in writing may be eligible for the College’s English for Academic Purposes course. A 2.1 or higher from a university in a majority English-speaking country within the last five years exempts you. Offer holders must upload English results by 11 June 2027.
  • Interviews: only in a small number of cases where a decision cannot be made from the application alone (in person or online); an interview invitation does not make an offer more or less likely.
  • Number of applications: up to two different programmes in the 2027 admissions year, and you cannot apply to the same programme more than once.

What should the portfolio show, and how do you prepare the video and personal statement?

RCA Master’s applicants upload three to five portfolio files, a 300-word personal statement, a video of up to two minutes and referee contact details via the Applicant Portal. The Service Design page says portfolios should show clear evidence of:

  • project topics that are challenging and aim to transform;
  • insight from user research, curiosity and willingness to uncover new insights;
  • empathy and understanding of people;
  • creative ideas that go beyond the expected and are built on user insight;
  • the ability to craft desirable, impactful solutions;
  • an understanding of implementation and how concepts can be delivered sustainably and viably;
  • the ability to shape services and experiences across physical, system or technological touchpoints so they are beautiful and desirable to users.

Personal statement (300 words): introduce yourself, your interests and why you are applying to the RCA and this programme; summarise your education and experience; say what you want to do in future.
Video (two minutes): record yourself on a phone or laptop speaking directly to camera; high production values are not needed. Explain why you want to be a service designer, give an example of your favourite service experience, describe the aspect of service design you are most passionate about, and say which portfolio project you like most and why.

What are the three 2027-entry deadlines and decision dates?

  • Round 1: opens 12 Oct 2026; deadline Friday 8 Jan 2027, 12 noon UK time; outcome by 19 Feb 2027.
  • Round 2: opens 11 Jan 2027; deadline Tuesday 23 Mar 2027, 12 noon; outcome by 5 May 2027.
  • Round 3: opens 24 Mar 2027; final Master’s deadline Wednesday 2 Jun 2027, 12 noon; outcome by 14 Jul 2027.
  • Rolling offers: the RCA reviews applications in the order received and sends offers on a rolling basis, so applying earlier means hearing sooner. You must accept an offer and pay the deposit within three weeks.

How much are fees, deposits and scholarships?

  • Tuition (September 2027 entry): Home (subsidised) £15,600; Overseas and EU £39,250 (EU students have been charged Overseas fees since 2021).
  • Deposit: £1,000 Home, £3,500 Overseas and EU; non-refundable and offset against fees.
  • Progression discount: £1,000 for RCA Graduate Diploma alumni moving to a Master’s; £2,000 for RCA Master’s alumni taking another Master’s.
  • Scholarships: most require you to apply in Round 1 or 2 and hold an offer before you are invited to apply. For example, in 2026/27 the RCA President & Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship was worth £9,000 towards fees, with Round 1 and 2 applicants assessed automatically; eligible countries and territories included Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and South Korea. Other awards have specific nationality or fee-status criteria. Budget also for materials, printing, laser cutting, 3D printing and similar costs.

Who is this programme for, and how can you improve your chances?

It suits people who want to move from designing a single image or interface to designing whole services and systems: applicants from product, communication, UX, architecture or interior design, and working professionals moving into innovation and strategy. If you are weighing a more research- and experiment-led HCI route, compare UCL’s MSc HCI; for US interaction design master’s options, see Cornell’s interaction design master’s degrees.

Author’s advice (not an official requirement): across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, the most common weakness among students switching to service design is a portfolio of polished final images that never shows who the user is, what was learned from interviews or observation, what changed as a result, and how it would be delivered. The RCA builds user insight, feasibility and teamwork into its selection criteria, so include at least one service blueprint or user journey per project and state your role in the team clearly. In the video, use two minutes to tell one service experience you genuinely love; that is more convincing than a memorised script.

Official sources: RCA Service Design MA programme page, RCA Eligibility and key dates (2027 entry), RCA Master’s application process (checked November 2026).

q.zh-Hant: 2027 入學申請截止日是哪天？

a.en: Round 1 is 8 Jan 2027, Round 2 is 23 Mar 2027 and Round 3 (final Master’s deadline) is 2 Jun 2027, all at 12 noon UK time. Offers are rolling, and most scholarships go to Round 1 and 2 applicants.

a.zh-Hant: 可以。需學士學位或至少 5 年工作經驗；要交 3–5 個作品集檔案、300 字個人陳述、2 分鐘對鏡頭影片與推薦人資料，作品集重點是使用者洞察、同理、創意與可落地性。
a.en: Yes. You need a bachelor’s degree or at least five years’ experience, and you submit 3–5 portfolio files, a 300-word statement, a two-minute to-camera video and referee details. The portfolio should show user insight, empathy, creativity and feasibility.

a.zh-Hant: 官網列出服務設計、創新、策略與創業等方向，任職於顧問公司、金融服務、政府、設計公司、文化機構、慈善組織或自行創業。

tldr.zh-Hant: 倫敦藝術大學倫敦傳播學院（UAL LCC）；180 學分、45 週／12 個月全日制（每週約 40 小時）；2027 年 9 月入學，將是新大樓首批學生之一；第一輪申請 2026/12/1、作品集＋影片 2026/12/15，結果 2027/3/12；第二輪申請 2027/2/17、作品集＋影片 2027/3/3，結果 2027/5/7（皆 GMT 下午 1 點，截止日）；學費 2027/28 本地 £14,710、國際 £31,510；IELTS 6.5、各項 5.5；陳述最多 500 字＋CV，之後經 PebblePad 交最多 20 頁／5 個項目作品集與 2–3 分鐘影片；可能線上面試 15–20 分鐘。
tldr.en: University of the Arts London, London College of Communication (UAL LCC); 180 credits, 45 weeks / 12 months full-time (about 40 hours a week); September 2027 start, among the first cohorts in the new building; Round 1 apply by 1 Dec 2026, portfolio and video by 15 Dec 2026, outcome 12 Mar 2027; Round 2 apply by 17 Feb 2027, portfolio and video by 3 Mar 2027, outcome 7 May 2027 (1pm GMT on deadline days); 2027/28 fees £14,710 Home, £31,510 International; IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 in each skill; personal statement (max 500 words) and CV first, then via PebblePad a portfolio of up to 20 pages / 5 projects and a 2–3 minute video; possible online interview of 15–20 minutes.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦藝術大學（University of the Arts London, UAL）倫敦傳播學院（London College of Communication, LCC）的 MA Interaction Design（互動設計碩士）是45 週／12 個月全日制，官網寫明合計 180 學分、每週約 40 小時，2027 年 9 月入學。申請分兩輪：第一輪 2026 年 12 月 1 日、第二輪 2027 年 2 月 17 日（皆為 GMT 下午 1 點）；初審後通常還要在 PebblePad 交數位作品集與 2–3 分鐘影片（第一輪作品截止 2026/12/15、第二輪 2027/3/3）。2027/28 學費英國本地 £14,710、國際學生 £31,510；英語為 IELTS 6.5、四項各不低於 5.5。課程偏批判與實驗：互動設計、實體運算、創意程式，以及批判設計、推測設計與後網路藝術等理論，畢業生去向包括 ByteDance、Lego、Mastercard 與獨立工作室，也有人繼續讀博或任教。

以下於 2026 年 11 月對照 UAL 課程頁與碩士申請頁查核；學費、時程與單元每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。舊文常見的 £29,990 或 2024–25 截止日已過時，請以官網 2027 入學數字為準。

文首封面是 Elephant & Castle 一帶的倫敦傳播學院外觀（無可辨識人物）。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（London - London College of Communication，Fred Rome，CC BY 2.0，縮圖）

UAL 互動設計碩士學什麼？跟 UX／HCI 差在哪？

官網把互動設計定義成：做出能在人、環境與系統之間開啟新關係的物件、空間與體驗，用來激發想像、討論與批判。課程強調maker-thinker：研究與實作連續對話，觸及批判科技研究、當代哲學、去殖民設計與媒體藝術理論；也鼓勵用表演、網路藝術、裝置、影像等跨媒介實驗。和偏產品流程或可用性評測的 UX／HCI 碩士相比，這裡更靠近批判設計、推測設計與後網路藝術，用設計質問數位隱私、氣候危機與社會經濟不平等。

  • 秋季 Block 1：Theories and Practices of Interaction Design——研討歷史與當代理論，並做一系列個人／團體實作項目，為後續練習定錨。
  • 春季 Block 2：Collaborative Unit——與外部夥伴的團體工作室項目（過往如 V&A、Design Museum、BBC Research and Development）；Explorative Practice——在選修路徑中深化主題，產出研究導向的實驗項目。
  • 夏季 Block 3：Masters Project（60 學分，研究與實作各半）——自訂研究領域，完成批判且技術上有野心的畢業項目，並反思其對世界與觀眾的影響。
  • 技能與方法：互動設計、實體運算、創意程式與新舊媒介；研究方法涵蓋批判設計、後人類中心設計、女性主義與去殖民理論、推測設計、批判資料研究。官網寫明整課共 5 個單元、合計 180 學分；無法讀完可依已修學分取得 Postgraduate Certificate（60）或 Diploma（120）。

跟哪些機構合作？畢業去哪？

課程提到可與國際藝文夥伴展出或合作，過往包括 V&A、Design Museum、Science Gallery、奧地利 Ars Electronica；Collaborative Unit 的 brief 也出現過 BBC R&D。畢業後可往互動藝術與設計、foresight／futures、跨領域工作室、創意科技與研究發展；官網列出的去向例子包括 ByteDance、Lego、Mastercard、IBM iX、獨立設計工作室，以及 PhD 與在 UAL 等校任教。

申請條件是什麼？一定要會寫程式嗎？

  • 學歷／背景：課程歡迎全球多元背景；常見來自相關榮譽學士（如平面／傳達設計領域）或其他同等學歷，也接受相關產業經驗。官網另有 APEL（先前學習認證）途徑，個案審查。
  • 程式：不是硬性入學門檻，但應能以基本編碼（例如 HTML／CSS）與同學溝通想法；有創意科技經驗是加分。課程會介紹多種語言與原型工具，但期待你在項目中自行深化技能。
  • 英語：課堂全英語；若英語非母語，官網要求 IELTS 6.5（或同等）且聽讀寫說四項皆至少 5.5。建議在申請中註明成績或已報考；CV 中也可附上英語成績資訊。細部同等考試請見 UAL Language Requirements 頁。
  • 選拔重點：相關領域的先備知識或潛力、團隊合作與獨立學習、批判熱情與研究導向設計能力；作品集應偏概念與研究，看得出思考與製作過程、願意在實體場域與網路數位系統中實驗並挑戰成見。
  • 面試：書面審後可能邀請線上面試，約 15–20 分鐘。

作品集、影片和個人陳述怎麼準備？

流程分步：先交初始申請（個人陳述＋CV），之後學校通常會請你經 PebblePad 上傳影片任務與數位作品集（影片放第一頁，其後是作品集）。

  • 個人陳述：最多 500 字，需包含選課理由、目前創作實踐與本課如何幫你達成規劃，以及相關學經歷（若無正式學歷更要寫清楚）。
  • CV：學歷、資格與相關工作／志工；有網站或媒體作品請附連結；非英語母語者請一併註明最近英語成績。
  • 影片（2–3 分鐘）：面對鏡頭、以英語說明——你的實踐如何置於更廣的政治、社會或文化脈絡；可談作品集既有作品，或未來意圖。官網強調不必高製作，但要聽得清楚。
  • 數位作品集：最多 20 頁（含影片頁）、最多來自 5 個項目；展現互動設計或相關領域的知識與投入、求知欲與研究所決心，並用過程說明從構思到成果怎麼發展。作品多半在小筆電螢幕上審，版面與文字請夠清楚。

2027 入學兩輪截止日與放榜時間？

  • 第一輪：申請截止 2026/12/1（GMT 下午 1 點）；數位作品集與影片截止 2026/12/15（GMT 下午 1 點）；結果 2027/3/12。
  • 第二輪：申請截止 2027/2/17（GMT 下午 1 點）；作品集與影片截止 2027/3/3（GMT 下午 1 點）；結果 2027/5/7。
  • 名額：若 2 月 17 日後仍有缺額，課程可能繼續開放至額滿。UAL 表示會為第二輪保留足夠名額，兩輪都會公平審核。
  • 注意：第一輪若未在指定期限交作品集／影片，申請不會自動轉入第二輪，也不能同課再申請第二輪。

學費與獎學金多少？新大樓怎麼回事？

  • 學費（2027/28 入學，官網標示可能再調）：Home £14,710；International £31,510。可分期；另需自備材料與設備等額外費用（見 Study costs）。
  • 獎學金／貸款：課程頁提到若你已完成 UAL 合格課程，可能適用 Progression discount；英國本地生可了解 Postgraduate Masters Loan，以及 Home／International 獎學金資訊（細節以 Funding 頁為準）。
  • 校區：LCC 在倫敦 Elephant & Castle（SE1 6SB）。官網寫你會是搬入馬路對面新大樓的首批學生之一；研究所學期日期可能與 UAL 標準學期不同，請另查 Term dates。設施包括 3D Workshop、Digital Hub、Advanced Technology Hub（創意程式、AI、實體運算、沉浸科技等）。

這個課程適合誰？怎麼準備比較有勝算？

適合想把互動從「把介面做好用」推到「用物件、空間與系統挑起批判對話」的人：傳達／平面、媒體藝術、創意科技、裝置，或已在產業裡做數位體驗、想補理論與實驗深度的申請者。若你更想走研究型 HCI，可對照 UCL MSc HCI；若偏服務系統與產業共創，可看 RCA MA Service Design。

作者建議（非官方要求）：在 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢中，申請這類批判互動課最常見的問題，是作品集只有酷炫最終裝置照，看不到研究提問、原型迭代與你如何回應觀眾或倫理爭議。UAL 明講作品集要概念與研究導向、要看見思考與製作過程——建議每個項目用 1–2 頁講清「問了什麼、試了什麼、改了什麼」；影片則用 2–3 分鐘把一件作品放回真實的政治／社會／文化脈絡，比空泛自我介紹更有用。

官方來源：UAL MA Interaction Design 課程頁、UAL Apply: postgraduate（2026 年 11 月查核）。
body.en:
The short answer: the University of the Arts London (UAL) London College of Communication (LCC) MA Interaction Design is a 45-week / 12-month full-time programme. UAL states 180 credits in total and about 40 hours of study a week, starting September 2027. There are two application rounds: 1 December 2026 (Round 1) and 17 February 2027 (Round 2), both at 1pm GMT. After the initial application you are usually asked to upload a digital portfolio and a 2–3 minute video on PebblePad (portfolio and video deadlines 15 Dec 2026 for Round 1 and 3 Mar 2027 for Round 2). Fees for 2027/28 are £14,710 Home and £31,510 International. English is IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each of the four skills. The course leans critical and experimental—interaction design, physical computing and creative coding alongside critical design, speculative design and post-internet art. Graduates have gone to ByteDance, Lego, Mastercard and independent studios, as well as PhD study and teaching.

Everything below was checked in November 2026 against the UAL course page and the postgraduate apply pages. Fees, dates and units can change each year, so check the official site before you apply. Older figures such as £29,990 or 2024–25 deadlines are outdated; use the 2027-entry numbers on the live pages.

The cover shows the London College of Communication buildings around Elephant & Castle (no identifiable people). Image: Wikimedia Commons (London - London College of Communication, Fred Rome, CC BY 2.0, resized)

What does the UAL MA Interaction Design teach, and how is it different from UX or HCI?

UAL defines interaction design as making objects, spaces and experiences that open new relations among humans, environments and systems—provoking imagination, discussion and critique. The course emphasises a maker-thinker mindset: research and practice in continuous dialogue, drawing on critical technology studies, contemporary philosophy, decolonial design and media art theory, and encouraging experiments across performance, net art, installation and film. Compared with UX or HCI master’s degrees that centre product process or usability evaluation, this programme sits closer to critical design, speculative design and post-internet art, using design to question digital privacy, the climate crisis and social and economic inequality.

  • Autumn, Block 1: Theories and Practices of Interaction Design—seminars on historical and contemporary theory plus a series of individual and group practical projects that frame your practice.
  • Spring, Block 2: Collaborative Unit—a group studio project with an external partner (past partners include the V&A, the Design Museum and BBC Research and Development); Explorative Practice—elective paths for a research-led experimental project.
  • Summer, Block 3: Masters Project (60 credits, 50% research / 50% practice)—your own research domain and a critically aware, technically ambitious major project, with reflection on its place in the world and for an audience.
  • Skills and methods: interaction design, physical computing, creative coding and new and traditional media; research approaches such as critical design, post-human-centred design, feminist and decolonial theory, speculative design and critical data studies. UAL states five units totalling 180 credits; exit awards are available at 60 credits (PG Certificate) and 120 credits (PG Diploma).

Which organisations does it work with, and where do graduates go?

The course mentions options to exhibit or collaborate with cultural partners; past names include the V&A, the Design Museum, the Science Gallery and Ars Electronica in Austria. Collaborative Unit briefs have also involved BBC R&D. Graduates work across interactive art and design, foresight and futures, interdisciplinary studio practice, creative technology and research. Destinations listed on the course page include ByteDance, Lego and Mastercard, IBM iX, independent studios, PhD programmes and teaching at UAL and other arts universities.

What are the entry requirements? Do I need to code?

  • Background: the course welcomes applicants from a broad range of backgrounds worldwide. Typical routes include an Honours degree in a field relevant to graphic or communication design, equivalent qualifications, or relevant industry experience. UAL also describes an APEL (Accreditation of Prior Learning) route, considered case by case.
  • Coding: not a formal entry requirement, but you should be comfortable with some basic coding (for example HTML/CSS) to communicate ideas; strong creative experience is an advantage. The course introduces languages and prototyping platforms, and expects you to deepen skills inside project work.
  • English: all classes are in English. If English is not your first language, UAL requires IELTS 6.5 (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5.5 in each of the four skills. State your score or booked test in the application; include English results on your CV when asked. See the Language Requirements page for accepted equivalents.
  • Selection: prior knowledge or potential in a relevant subject, teamwork and independent study, critical enthusiasm and capacity for research-led design. Portfolios should be conceptual and research-based, showing thinking and making, curiosity to experiment, and a willingness to work with networked digital systems in the physical realm.
  • Interview: you may be invited to an online interview of about 15–20 minutes after review.

How should you prepare the portfolio, video and personal statement?

Apply in steps: first the initial application (personal statement and CV); then UAL usually asks you to upload a video task and digital portfolio on PebblePad (video on the first page, then the portfolio).

  • Personal statement: maximum 500 words, covering why you chose the course, your current creative practice and how the course supports your plans, plus relevant education and experience (especially if you lack formal qualifications).
  • CV: education, qualifications and relevant work or volunteering; include links to web or media projects; if English is not your first language, add your latest English test score.
  • Video (2–3 minutes): face the camera and speak in English about how your practice sits in wider political, social or cultural contexts—referring to portfolio work or future intentions. High production values are not required; clarity is.
  • Digital portfolio: maximum 20 pages including the video task, from a maximum of 5 projects; show knowledge and engagement in interaction design or related fields, intellectual curiosity and commitment to postgraduate study, and process from ideas to outcomes. Assume review on a small laptop screen, so keep layouts and text readable.

What are the two 2027-entry deadlines and decision dates?

  • Round 1: apply by 1 Dec 2026, 1pm GMT; digital portfolio and video by 15 Dec 2026, 1pm GMT; decision outcome 12 Mar 2027.
  • Round 2: apply by 17 Feb 2027, 1pm GMT; portfolio and video by 3 Mar 2027, 1pm GMT; decision outcome 7 May 2027.
  • Places: if places remain after 17 February, the course may stay open until full. UAL says it holds enough places for Round 2 so both rounds are considered fairly.
  • Caution: if you apply in Round 1 and miss your portfolio/video deadline, the application is not moved to Round 2 and you cannot reapply to the same course in Round 2.

How much are fees and funding, and what about the new building?

  • Tuition (2027/28 entry; subject to change for later years): Home £14,710; International £31,510. Instalments are available; budget separately for materials and equipment (see Study costs).
  • Scholarships / loans: the course page notes a possible Progression discount if you completed a qualifying UAL course; Home students can explore the Postgraduate Masters Loan, plus Home and International scholarships (details on UAL funding pages).
  • Campus: LCC is at Elephant & Castle, London SE1 6SB. UAL says you will be among the first students in the new building just across the road from the current site; postgraduate term dates at LCC can differ from standard UAL dates. Facilities highlighted on the course page include the 3D Workshop, Digital Hub and Advanced Technology Hub (creative coding, AI, physical computing, immersive technology and more).

Who is this programme for, and how can you improve your chances?

It suits applicants who want to move interaction beyond “make the interface usable” toward “use objects, spaces and systems to provoke critical conversation”: communication and graphic design, media art, creative technology, installation, or industry practitioners seeking deeper theory and experimentation. If you prefer research-led HCI, compare UCL’s MSc HCI; for service systems and industry co-creation, see RCA MA Service Design.

Author’s advice (not an official requirement): across 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, the most common weakness for critical interaction applications is a portfolio of striking final installation shots with no research question, prototype iterations or response to audiences and ethics. UAL asks for conceptual, research-based portfolios that show thinking and making—so give each project one or two pages on what you asked, what you tried and what changed. In the video, spend 2–3 minutes placing one piece in a real political, social or cultural context; that lands better than a generic self-introduction.

Official sources: UAL MA Interaction Design course page, UAL Apply: postgraduate (checked November 2026).

title.zh-Hant: GSA 設計創新與互動設計碩士 MDes Interaction Design 怎麼申請？暫定學費 £26,420、Forres 高地校區、滾動申請與雅思 6.5（2026 年 11 月官網查核）
title.en: How do you apply to GSA’s MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design? Provisional £26,420 fees, Forres Highlands campus, rolling direct applications, IELTS 6.5 (checked November 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: GSA MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design：一年全日制、Forres 高地校區；UCAS 暫定學費本地 £10,700、國際 £26,420，開課 2027/9/14；直接向 GSA 滾動申請，獎學金建議 2027/2/28 前送齊；雅思 6.5（各項 6.0）；短影片必繳、作品集選填但建議。
summary.en: GSA MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design: one-year full-time at the Forres Highlands campus; UCAS provisional fees Home £10,700 / International £26,420, start 14 Sep 2027; direct rolling applications to GSA, scholarship tip by 28 Feb 2027; IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each); required video, optional but advised portfolio.

tldr.zh-Hant: 格拉斯哥藝術學院創新與科技學院；MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design；180 學分、一年全日制；主校區 Highlands and Islands／Forres（Altyre），非格拉斯哥市中心為主；學位由格拉斯哥大學驗證；UCAS 2027 開課 9/14、學費暫定 Home £10,700／國際 £26,420；向 GSA 直接滾動申請，獎學金建議 2027/2/28 前交齊申請與數位作品集；IELTS 6.5、各項 6.0；個人陳述最多 500 字；Design Innovation 指引：短影片必繳（有作品集約 4 分鐘／無約 8 分鐘），作品集選填建議約 15 頁、至少 3 個項目；2027 專用指引以 2026/11/1 起官網公布為準。
tldr.en: GSA School of Innovation and Technology; MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design; 180 credits, one year full-time; Highlands and Islands / Forres (Altyre), not primarily Glasgow city centre; University of Glasgow validated; UCAS 2027 start 14 Sep; provisional fees Home £10,700 / International £26,420; direct rolling applications; scholarship tip complete application + Digital Portfolio by 28 Feb 2027; IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 each; personal statement max 500 words; Design Innovation guide: required video (~4 min with folio / ~8 without), optional ~15-page folio with at least 3 projects; confirm 2027 guidelines when published from 1 Nov 2026.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：格拉斯哥藝術學院（Glasgow School of Art, GSA）創新與科技學院（School of Innovation and Technology）的 MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design（設計創新與互動設計碩士）是一年全日制（約 9 月至翌年 8 月），學位由格拉斯哥大學（University of Glasgow）頒授驗證，學分合計 180（SCQF Level 11）。主修校區在蘇格蘭高地與群島創意校區（Highlands and Islands Creative Campus，Forres／Altyre），不是格拉斯哥市中心畫室為主。UCAS 2027 年條目列出開課日2027 年 9 月 14 日；學費標為暫定英國本地／Home £10,700、歐盟與國際 £26,420（可能調整）。英語要求為 IELTS 6.5（各項不低於 6.0）。申請走 GSA直接線上申請（Innovation & Technology 學程），採滾動審核；若要申請 GSA 獎學金，官網建議申請與數位作品集至遲於2027 年 2 月 28 日前送齊。

以下於 2026 年 11 月對照 GSA 課程頁、How to apply、Innovation School 申請指引與 UCAS 2027 條目查核；學費、時程與指引每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。舊文常見的過時國際學費或固定截止日，請以官網與最新 Applicant Guidelines 為準。

文首封面是 Forres 高地校區建築外觀（無可辨識人物）。圖片來源：格拉斯哥藝術學院 官網

GSA 互動設計碩士學什麼？跟一般 UX／HCI 差在哪？

官網定位：當代經驗與人際互動常被新科技中介，互動設計要確保科技真正加分於社會；GSA 的 Interaction Design以人為本，而非以技術為中心，用多種方法改善利害關係人之間的互動與溝通，處理真實情境問題。School of Innovation and Technology（SIT）進一步說明：課程探索實體—數位與具身互動的原型與迭代，主題可涵蓋心理健康、可穿戴與社會永續等；強調動手製作、美學與可及性，並刻意拉開與「純螢幕 UI／UX 課」的距離。

結構上屬 Design Innovation 碩士套件之一：先有共同的設計創新基礎，再進入 Interaction Design 專精工作室。課程規格（2026–27）示例階段包括：Core Research Methods、Studio（Design Innovation Practice）、選修、Studio（Interaction Design），以及期末 Masters Research Project；總計 180 學分。每年 Winter School 在 Forres 校區舉辦，可與國際設計院校師生短期共學。

校區在哪？為什麼是 Forres 而不是格拉斯哥市中心？

官網明確寫 Location：Highlands + Islands。創新學院高地校區位於 Forres 附近 Altyre Estate 的一級登錄義大利風格建築群（Blairs Farm Steading），提供工作室、工坊、展覽與原型空間；從 Forres 車站可搭車或計程車抵達，自 Inverness 車站／機場約 45 分鐘車程。同一 Design Innovation 套件中，例如 Service Design 等路徑主要在格拉斯哥校區授課——選校時先確認路徑對應校區，不要預設「讀 GSA 就一定住格拉斯哥市中心」。

2027 入學怎麼申請？有沒有固定截止日？

GSA How to apply 頁：所有碩士Taught課程都是向 GSA 直接申請；Innovation & Technology 清單含本課。申請採滾動審核，沒有固定輪次；名額可能提早額滿，宜儘早送件。若計畫申請 GSA 獎學金，建議申請表與數位作品集至遲 2027 年 2 月 28 日前完成，以便及時收到錄取結果銜接獎學金時程。

一般文件（How to apply）：線上申請表、個人陳述（最多 500 字）、學歷證明與成績單、1 封學術推薦、有照片的身分證件；需 Student Visa 者另交英語成績。收件後約 3 日內核發數位作品集上傳帳號；作品集送出後，Stage 1 決策目標約 30 日內（可能直接錄取、邀面試或不通過）；面試後約 14 日內給結果。

課程頁注明：頁上申請指引目前標為2026 入學；2027 入學指引預計自 2026 年 11 月 1 日起提供。送件前請下載當年度 Design Innovation Applicant Guidelines，勿只憑舊 PDF 或第三方摘要。

影片與作品集怎麼準備？（以已公布的 Design Innovation 指引為準）

Innovation School《Postgraduate Taught Degrees in Design Innovation》Applicant Guidelines（標題為 2026 年 9 月入學）說明申請兩部分：Part 1 短影片必繳；Part 2 數位作品集為選填但強烈建議（學院歡迎非設計背景，作品集非硬性門檻）。影片須本人出鏡、以英語對鏡頭清楚說話；有作品集時最長約 4 分鐘、無作品集最長約 8 分鐘；禁止 AI 生成影片、改聲或刻意加速。未提供影片連結者無法進入評審。

若繳作品集：可接受單一 PDF（約 15 頁；過長可能無法完整審閱）或約 15 張圖；建議至少 3 個項目，呈現研究到提案的過程、協作／社區經驗與專業脈絡。How to apply 總則另寫數位作品集 PDF 最多 15 頁，以及作品集陳述最多 500 字——實際上傳欄位以當年度系統與指引為準。UCAS 條目另提及作品集與支援影片，並寫有作品集截止日；但本課官方申請管道是 GSA 直接申請與滾動制，請以 GSA How to apply 與最新 Applicant Guidelines 為準，勿把 UCAS 資訊頁的日期當成 GSA 硬截止。

入學條件與雅思要多少？

課程規格／UCAS：通常需大學榮譽學士（Honours）或同等學歷，任何學科皆可，或以同等專業實務申請；另通常需作品集、支援影片、學術推薦與個人陳述，並可能面試。Design Innovation 指引補充：歡迎非設計背景，但需展現對主題與當代實踐的理解；學歷不足時仍可能依作品集與／或相關專業經驗審酌。

英語：Innovation 套件（含 Interaction Design）與 GSA 2027/28 英語要求表均寫 IELTS Academic／UKVI 總分 6.5、各項至少 6.0（或官網列出的同等考試）。成績須在開課日前兩年內（UCAS／簽證相關說明）。

學費多少？還有哪些成本？

截至查核時，GSA 公開學費總表不易直接對到 2027 單一數字；UCAS 2027 年條目將本課學費標為暫定（provisional）：英國本地等 £10,700、歐盟與國際 £26,420，並註明可能變更。材料、工坊、參訪等另見 Indicative Programme Costs（Design Innovation 各專精共用），例如材料約 £40–£110、與評量相關的參訪約 £30–£55（僅供預算參考）。獎學金資訊見 GSA Scholarships 專頁；頁上曾列出 2026/27 獎學金截止示例，2027 週期請以當年公布為準。

這個課程適合誰？姊妹路徑怎麼選？

適合想把互動從「介面交付」拉回人、情境、實體原型與社會影響的申請者——例如對可穿戴、公共服務觸點、心理健康科技或偏鄉／社區共創有興趣，並能接受一年住在高地校園、高度自驅與協作的節奏。若你的重心是服務藍圖、組織轉型或都會產業網絡，可比較同套件的 MDes Design Innovation and Service Design（指引標示主要在格拉斯哥校區）等路徑，再決定校區與方法取向。

我們以超過 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、校區差異與作品敘事；任何學費與截止日仍以你送件當下的 GSA 官網為準。
body.en:
The short answer: Glasgow School of Art (GSA) School of Innovation and Technology’s MDes Design Innovation and Interaction Design is a one-year full-time award (about September–August), validated by the University of Glasgow, totalling 180 credits (SCQF Level 11). The primary location is the Highlands and Islands Creative Campus in Forres / Altyre—not a Glasgow city-centre studio as the default. UCAS’s 2027 listing shows a start date of 14 September 2027 and provisional fees of £10,700 (UK/Home) and £26,420 (EU & International), subject to change. English is typically IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component. Applications for Innovation & Technology programmes go direct to GSA on a rolling basis; if you want a GSA scholarship, the How to apply page recommends submitting the completed application and Digital Portfolio by 28 February 2027.

Figures below were checked in November 2026 against GSA’s programme page, How to apply, Design Innovation Applicant Guidelines, and the UCAS 2027 course page. Fees, timelines and guidance PDFs change—re-check before you submit. Discard outdated third-party fee or deadline figures.

Cover image: Highlands campus buildings at Forres (no identifiable people). Image source: Glasgow School of Art official site

What do you study—and how is it different from typical UX / HCI?

GSA frames Interaction Design around people rather than technology: mediating real-world problems by improving interaction and communication among stakeholders. SIT describes prototyping physical–digital and embodied interactions on themes such as mental wellbeing, wearable technologies and social sustainability, with a hands-on, aesthetic and accessibility-led studio culture that is positioned as an alternative to conventional on-screen UI/UX courses.

It sits in the Design Innovation suite: shared innovation foundations, then an Interaction Design studio track, ending in a Masters Research Project within 180 credits. An annual Winter School in Forres brings international peers for intensive workshops.

Where is the campus—and why Forres, not Glasgow city centre?

Official location: Highlands + Islands. The campus occupies Category A–listed Italianate buildings at Blairs Farm Steading on the Altyre Estate near Forres, with studios, workshops and exhibition spaces. Sister pathways such as Service Design are listed primarily at the Glasgow campus in the Design Innovation applicant guide—confirm campus before you assume a city-centre year.

How do you apply for 2027 entry—and is there a hard deadline?

How to apply: postgraduate taught applications are made direct to GSA; Innovation & Technology includes this MDes. Review is rolling—some programmes fill early, so apply as soon as you can. For GSA scholarships, submit the completed form and Digital Portfolio by 28 February 2027 where possible.

Typical documents: online form, personal statement (max 500 words), certificates/transcripts, one academic reference, photographic ID; Student Visa applicants also need English evidence. After documents arrive, Digital Portfolio login details are usually issued within about three days. Stage 1 decisions are targeted within about 30 days of portfolio submission; interview decisions within about 14 days.

The programme page states that on-page guidelines are for 2026 entry and that 2027 guidelines will be available from 1 November 2026. Download the current Design Innovation Applicant Guidelines before you finalise materials.

Video and portfolio—what do the published Design Innovation guidelines say?

The Design Innovation Applicant Guidelines titled for September 2026 entry describe Part 1: a short video (required) and Part 2: a digital folio (optional but strongly advised)—non-design backgrounds are welcome, so a design portfolio is not mandatory, though including one is better if you have it. The video must show you in frame speaking English to camera; up to about 4 minutes with a portfolio or 8 minutes without; AI-generated video, voice alteration or artificial speed-up are not allowed. Applications without a video link cannot be assessed.

If you submit a folio: one PDF of about 15 pages (longer books may not be fully read) or about 15 images; aim for at least 3 projects, showing process from research to proposals, collaboration/community work and professional context. The general How to apply page also cites a Digital Portfolio PDF maximum of 15 pages and a portfolio statement (max 500 words). UCAS may show a portfolio date for information listings—treat GSA’s direct, rolling process and current guidelines as authoritative.

Entry requirements and IELTS

Minimum: an undergraduate Honours degree or equivalent in any subject, or equivalent professional practice; normally a portfolio, supporting video, academic references and personal statement; interview possible. Non-design applicants should still evidence understanding of the subject and contemporary practice.

English for this Innovation suite: IELTS 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each component (or listed equivalents). Test dates must fall within two years of the start date where visa rules apply.

Fees and other costs

UCAS 2027 lists provisional tuition of £10,700 (Home) and £26,420 (EU & International), subject to change—confirm on GSA finance pages when updated. Indicative Programme Costs for Design Innovation specialisms give ballpark materials (£40–£110) and assessable site-visit budgets (£30–£55). Check Scholarships for the current cycle separately from tuition.

Who is this for—and how do sister pathways differ?

Best fit if you want interaction beyond screen UI: people, context, physical prototypes and social impact, and you can thrive in a one-year Highlands campus community. If your focus is service blueprints or organisational change in an urban network, compare MDes Design Innovation and Service Design (Glasgow campus in the applicant guide) and other named pathways before choosing.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants align portfolio stories with official numbers and campus differences—always re-check GSA’s live pages at submission time.

q.zh-Hant: GSA MDes Interaction Design 讀多久？在哪個校區？
q.en: How long is the GSA MDes Interaction Design, and which campus is it on?

a.zh-Hant: 一年全日制（約 9 月至翌年 8 月）、180 學分；主校區為 Highlands and Islands Creative Campus（Forres／Altyre），不是以格拉斯哥市中心畫室為主。學位由格拉斯哥大學驗證。
a.en: One year full-time (about September–August), 180 credits; primary campus is the Highlands and Islands Creative Campus (Forres / Altyre), not Glasgow city centre as default. The award is validated by the University of Glasgow.

q.zh-Hant: 2027 入學怎麼申請？有固定截止日嗎？
q.en: How do you apply for 2027 entry, and is there a fixed deadline?

a.zh-Hant: Innovation & Technology 學程向 GSA 直接申請，採滾動審核、無固定輪次；宜儘早。若要申請 GSA 獎學金，官網建議申請與數位作品集至遲 2027 年 2 月 28 日前送齊。
a.en: Apply direct to GSA for Innovation & Technology programmes on a rolling basis with no fixed rounds; apply early. For GSA scholarships, aim to submit the completed application and Digital Portfolio by 28 February 2027.

q.zh-Hant: 學費多少？是最終數字嗎？
q.en: What are the fees—and are they final?

a.zh-Hant: UCAS 2027 條目標為暫定：英國本地／Home £10,700、歐盟與國際 £26,420，可能調整；送件前再核對 GSA 學費／財務頁。材料與參訪另有 Indicative Programme Costs。
a.en: UCAS 2027 lists provisional Home £10,700 and EU & International £26,420, subject to change—re-check GSA finance pages. Materials and visits have separate indicative programme costs.

q.zh-Hant: 雅思要幾分？
q.en: What IELTS score is required?

a.zh-Hant: 本課所屬 Design Innovation／Innovation & Technology 套件：IELTS Academic／UKVI 總分 6.5、各項至少 6.0（或官網同等考試）。
a.en: For this Design Innovation / Innovation & Technology suite: IELTS Academic/UKVI 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each component (or listed equivalents).

q.zh-Hant: 作品集一定要交嗎？影片呢？
q.en: Is a portfolio mandatory? What about the video?

a.zh-Hant: 已公布的 Design Innovation 指引：短影片必繳；數位作品集選填但強烈建議（約 15 頁或 15 圖、至少 3 個項目）。2027 專用指引請以官網自 2026/11/1 起公布版本為準。
a.en: Published Design Innovation guidelines: a short video is required; a digital folio is optional but strongly advised (~15 pages or 15 images, at least 3 projects). Confirm the 2027 PDF when GSA publishes it (stated from 1 November 2026).

q.zh-Hant: 跟 MDes Service Design 有何不同？
q.en: How does it differ from MDes Service Design?

a.zh-Hant: 同屬 Design Innovation 套件，但 Interaction Design 主校區在 Forres 高地，側重實體—數位／具身互動；Service Design 在申請指引中標為格拉斯哥校區授課，方法與產業網絡偏服務系統。選校先對校區與主題。
a.en: Both sit in the Design Innovation suite, but Interaction Design is based at the Forres Highlands campus with a physical–digital / embodied focus; Service Design is listed at the Glasgow campus in the applicant guide, with a service-systems emphasis. Match campus and method first.
