title.zh-Hant: 愛丁堡大學 Design Informatics 設計資訊學碩士怎麼申請？MSc 與 MA 怎麼選、國際學費 £47,680、雅思 7.0、2027 兩輪截止（2026 年 11 月官網查核）
title.en: How do you apply to Edinburgh’s Design Informatics master’s? MSc vs MA, £47,680 international fees, IELTS 7.0 and two 2027 deadline rounds (checked November 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 愛丁堡大學 Design Informatics：MSc（資訊學院）與 MA（ECA）兩個入口、同屆合班；一年全日制、2027/9 開課、180 學分；2027/8 學費英國 £18,900、國際 £47,680；MSc 雅思 7.0（三項 6.5、一項 6.0）、MA 雅思 7.0（各項 6.0）；MSc 截止 3/31、5/31，MA 截止 2026/12/14、2027/5/31；免申請費。
summary.en: Edinburgh Design Informatics: two routes—MSc (Informatics) and MA (ECA)—in one cohort; one year full-time from September 2027, 180 credits; 2027/8 fees £18,900 UK / £47,680 international; MSc IELTS 7.0 (6.5×3, 6.0×1), MA IELTS 7.0 (6.0 each); MSc deadlines 31 Mar and 31 May, MA 14 Dec 2026 and 31 May 2027; no application fee.

tldr.zh-Hant: 愛丁堡大學 Design Informatics 碩士＝資料 × 設計 × 社會；MSc 由資訊學院招生（資工／工程／心理／語言學等＋程式能力證明），MA 由 ECA 招生（設計／科技／運算相關，或相關專業經驗）；一年全日制、180 學分、2027 年 9 月開課；人人寫程式、人人做實體物件；工作室在 Bayes Centre；2027/8 學費英國 £18,900、國際／歐盟 £47,680；MSc 訂金 £1,500、MA 免訂金；MSc 截止 3/31、5/31，MA 截止 2026/12/14、2027/5/31；免申請費；Degree Finder 未列作品集為必繳。
tldr.en: Edinburgh Design Informatics = data × design × society; MSc admitted by Informatics (computing/engineering/psychology/linguistics etc. plus programming evidence), MA by ECA (design/technology/computing or relevant professional experience); one year full-time, 180 credits, September 2027 start; everyone codes and makes physical objects; studio in the Bayes Centre; 2027/8 fees £18,900 UK, £47,680 International/EU; MSc £1,500 deposit, MA none; MSc deadlines 31 Mar and 31 May, MA 14 Dec 2026 and 31 May 2027; no application fee; Degree Finder does not list a portfolio as required.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：愛丁堡大學（The University of Edinburgh）的 Design Informatics（設計資訊學）碩士是同一個課程的兩條入口：MSc 由資訊學院（School of Informatics）招生，給資工、AI、工程、心理、語言學等偏技術背景；MA 由愛丁堡藝術學院（Edinburgh College of Art, ECA）招生，給設計、科技或運算相關背景。兩者都是一年全日制、2027 年 9 月開課、180 學分，MA 與 MSc 學生同一屆一起上大部分核心課。官網 2027/28 學費兩條路線相同：蘇格蘭及英國其他地區 £18,900、國際／歐盟 £47,680（每年）。英語：MSc 要 IELTS 7.0（三項 6.5、另一項 6.0）；MA 要 IELTS 7.0（各項 6.0）。截止：MSc 兩輪 3 月 31 日／5 月 31 日；MA 兩輪 2026 年 12 月 14 日／2027 年 5 月 31 日。兩條路線都免申請費。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月對照愛丁堡大學 Degree Finder（2027 入學版）、官方學費查詢頁與 Institute for Design Informatics 課程網站查核；學費、截止與入學條件每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。

文首封面是愛丁堡大學 Bayes Centre 外觀（無可辨識人物）；Design Informatics 工作室就設在這棟樓，配有 3D 列印、hacklab 與實體製作設備。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Bayes Centre, University of Edinburgh，Delphine Dallison，CC BY-SA 4.0，縮圖）

Design Informatics 學什麼？跟一般 UX／互動設計碩士差在哪？

官網的核心主張是「資料是一種設計媒材」：用資料科學打底、以設計思考做反思性研究，探索資料驅動技術在社會中的角色，以及它成為公共善（social good）的可能。MSc 頁面列出的學習內容包括：資料科學基礎與其如何融入設計流程；使用者研究、共同設計（co-design）與思辨設計（speculative design）在資料系統中的案例；資料視覺化、資料實體化（data physicalisation）、實體運算與回應式材料的程式設計；負責任設計與倫理。應用情境涵蓋社會挑戰與永續發展目標、健康照護、時尚、金融、都市空間與智慧城市，也會觸及 AI 發展如何改變設計流程。

和多數 UX／HCI 碩士最大的不同：官網明寫每個人都要寫程式，每個人都要做實體物件；設計背景與資工背景的學生混編成團隊，課程與畢業項目常在公開展覽中呈現成果。MA 頁面則強調實驗性、思辨性與批判性的實作——把資料當材料來「玩」，做出實體與數位的資料作品。

MSc 和 MA 怎麼選？差別在哪？

學術背景是分流關鍵。MSc 要求英國 2:1 榮譽學士或同等學歷，科系限資工、資訊、AI、物理、工程、心理、哲學、語言學或神經科學，並須證明扎實的程式能力（HTML 與網頁設計不算；R、Matlab、C/C++、Java、Python 算），可用相關 MOOC 證書或已通過的程式課證明；若學位有畢業項目，成績宜為 B 以上。官網也明說：數位設計、工業設計、藝術、建築等背景應申請 MA。MA 要求英國 2:1 或同等學歷，相關科系如設計、科技或運算；學歷不完全符合但有相關專業經驗者也歡迎申請。

課程結構。MSc 必修：Histories and Futures of Technology、Data Science for Design、Case Studies in Design Informatics 1、Design with Data、Informatics Project Proposal（各 20 學分）與 Master's Dissertation Project（60 學分），另選修 20 學分（可跨資訊學院、ECA、Edinburgh Futures Institute 等）。MA 必修四門 20 學分核心課（同名系列）加 60 學分自主畢業項目，另選修 40 學分。兩條路線在畢業項目時程與選修上有差異，其餘大多同堂。

時程。第一學期（9–12 月）以講課、導修與小組實作建立方法；第二學期（1–3 月）進入進階項目並準備個人研究／設計項目；夏季完成畢業論文／項目，MSc 頁面寫明提交期限通常在 8 月中，且期間須留在愛丁堡。

2027 申請截止日是什麼時候？要交哪些文件？

MSc（資訊學院）：分兩輪，第一輪 3 月 31 日截止、5 月 31 日前決定或順延；第二輪 5 月 31 日截止、7 月 31 日前決定。資訊學院頁面表示 2027 入學自 2026 年 10 月初開放申請。可能對特別優秀者提前發 offer，但多數申請會等到截止日後一併審；若名額滿可能提前關閉。同一申請人最多被考慮 3 份申請。支援文件須在截止前補齊，且送出申請後 28 天內未補件會被自動拒絕。錄取後需繳 £1,500 訂金（抵學費）。

MA（ECA）：採 gathered field 兩輪制——第一輪 2026 年 12 月 14 日（週一）截止、最晚 2027 年 3 月 18 日前收到結果；第二輪 2027 年 5 月 31 日（週一）截止、最晚 2027 年 6 月 30 日前收到結果。若打算念學校的語言先修課，請在第一輪申請。最多可考慮 5 份申請；送件時不需推薦信（必要時校方再索取），也不需繳訂金。

兩條路線的線上申請都要個人陳述與相關知識／技能說明，並上傳學位證書與成績單、英語證明、非英文文件的認證翻譯（MSc 另列推薦信）。Degree Finder 頁面未把作品集列為必繳文件；實際清單以開始申請後系統顯示為準。MSc 的個人陳述須說明為何對本課有興趣、你在設計／藝術／資訊視覺化的背景或興趣、程式能力，並展現對新科技社會影響的深刻理解。

學費、生活費與英語要求是多少？

官方學費查詢頁（2027/8）：MSc 與 MA 皆為蘇格蘭 £18,900、英國其他地區 £18,900、國際／歐盟 £47,680（一年）。愛丁堡大學畢業生可享 10% 學費折扣。學校估計 2026–2027 年研究生在愛丁堡平均生活費約 £18,504／年（£1,542／月）。英語成績（IELTS、TOEFL、Oxford ELLT 等）須在開課當月 1 日前兩年內；不接受 IELTS One Skill Retake。MSc：IELTS Academic 總分 7.0、三項 6.5、一項 6.0；MA：總分 7.0、各項 6.0。

在哪裡上課？畢業後做什麼？

MSc 頁面說明課程以位於 Bayes Centre 的 Design Informatics 工作室為核心，配有 3D 列印、hacklab、焊接點、Arduino 等設備，也能使用 ECA 的金工與木工工坊；資訊學院主教學大樓 Appleton Tower 有 200 台以上高規電腦。MA 頁面則提到 Institute for Design Informatics 的 Inspace 展覽空間，以及雷射切割、3D 列印等數位製造工坊；ECA Lauriston 校區整修預計 2027 年 4 月完工。MSc 課程可能與 TravelTech Scotland、蘇格蘭國家圖書館、愛丁堡市議會、蘇格蘭國家博物館等外部夥伴合作；MA 有年度參訪行程。

官網列出的近年畢業生職稱包括 UX 設計師、產品經理、系統分析師、AI 工程師、研究顧問、資深軟體工程師；也有不少人走向創業或繼續攻讀博士。

這個碩士適合誰？

適合想把資料、程式與實體製作放進設計作品的人：設計／建築背景、想補上運算與資料能力者選 MA；資工、工程、心理或語言學背景、想學設計方法與思辨實作者選 MSc。若你只想做螢幕介面優化、不想寫程式或做實體原型，這個課程的節奏可能不適合。申請材料的重點是把「為什麼是資料 × 設計 × 社會」講清楚，並用過去的項目證明你能動手做。

我們以超過 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、選對 MA／MSc 入口並梳理項目敘事；任何學費與截止日仍以送件當下的愛丁堡大學官網為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: The University of Edinburgh’s Design Informatics master’s has two doors into one programme: the MSc, admitted by the School of Informatics for computing, AI, engineering, psychology, linguistics and similar technical backgrounds; and the MA, admitted by Edinburgh College of Art (ECA) for design, technology or computing-related backgrounds. Both are one year full-time, starting September 2027, 180 credits, and MA and MSc students take most core courses together as one cohort. Official 2027/28 tuition is identical for both: £18,900 (Scotland and rest of UK) and £47,680 (International/EU) per year. English: MSc needs IELTS 7.0 (6.5 in three components, 6.0 in the fourth); MA needs IELTS 7.0 (6.0 in each). Deadlines: MSc rounds 31 March / 31 May; MA rounds 14 December 2026 / 31 May 2027. Neither route charges an application fee.

Figures below were checked in November 2026 against Edinburgh’s Degree Finder (2027 entry), the official tuition-fee lookup and the Institute for Design Informatics programme site. Fees, deadlines and entry rules can change each year—re-check before you apply.

The cover shows the University of Edinburgh Bayes Centre (no identifiable people); the Design Informatics studio sits in this building, with 3D printing, a hacklab and making facilities. Image: Wikimedia Commons (Bayes Centre, University of Edinburgh, Delphine Dallison, CC BY-SA 4.0, resized)

What does Design Informatics teach, and how is it different from a typical UX or interaction design master’s?

The programme’s premise is that data is a medium for design: data science provides the groundwork, design thinking underpins reflective research through design, and the focus is on the role of data-driven technologies in society and their potential as a social good. The MSc page lists data-science fundamentals for design; case studies in user research, co-design and speculative design; programming for data visualisation, data physicalisation, physical computing and responsive materials; and responsible design and ethics. Contexts include societal challenges and the SDGs, health and care, fashion, finance, urban spaces and smart cities, plus how emerging AI changes design processes.

The key difference from most UX/HCI degrees: the official page states that everyone writes code and everyone makes physical objects. Designers and computer scientists work in mixed teams, and several courses end in public shows. The MA page stresses experimental, speculative and critical practice—playing with data as a material to make physical and digital data artefacts.

MSc or MA: which route should you choose?

Academic background decides. The MSc asks for a UK 2:1 honours degree or equivalent in computer science, informatics, AI, physics, engineering, psychology, philosophy, linguistics or neuroscience, plus evidence of solid programming skills (HTML and web design do not count; R, Matlab, C/C++, Java and Python do), shown by a relevant MOOC certificate or a passed programming course; a final-project mark of B or higher if your degree has one. The page says applicants from digital design, industrial design, art, architecture and related subjects are expected to apply to the MA. The MA asks for a UK 2:1 or equivalent in a relevant subject such as design, technology or computing, and also welcomes applicants with relevant professional experience who do not meet the academic requirement.

Structure. MSc compulsory courses: Histories and Futures of Technology, Data Science for Design, Case Studies in Design Informatics 1, Design with Data, Informatics Project Proposal (20 credits each) and the Master’s Dissertation Project (60 credits), plus 20 credits of options (from Informatics, ECA, the Edinburgh Futures Institute and more). The MA has four 20-credit core courses from the same series, a self-directed 60-credit dissertation and 40 credits of options. The routes differ mainly in dissertation timetable and options.

Timeline. Semester 1 (September–December) builds methods through lectures, tutorials and group practicals; semester 2 (January–March) moves to advanced projects and preparing an individual research/design project; the dissertation runs over summer, with MSc submission usually in mid-August and students expected to stay in Edinburgh.

When are the 2027 deadlines, and what documents do you need?

MSc (School of Informatics): two rounds—Round 1 closes 31 March with decisions or roll-over by 31 May; Round 2 closes 31 May with decisions by 31 July. Informatics says 2027 applications open in early October 2026. A few outstanding candidates may get early offers, but most applications are held until the deadline, and applications may close early if demand is high. No more than 3 applications per applicant are considered. Supporting documents must be in by the deadline, and applications are automatically rejected if documents are not supplied within 28 days of submission. Offer-holders pay a £1,500 deposit (credited to tuition).

MA (ECA): gathered-field rounds—Round 1 closes Monday 14 December 2026 (decision no later than 18 March 2027); Round 2 closes Monday 31 May 2027 (decision no later than 30 June 2027). Apply in Round 1 if you plan to take the pre-sessional English course. Up to 5 applications are considered; no reference is needed at submission (ECA may request one later) and no deposit is required.

Both routes require a personal statement and details of relevant knowledge/skills, plus degree certificates and transcripts, English evidence and certified translations where needed (the MSc also lists references). The Degree Finder pages do not list a portfolio as a required document; the full checklist appears when you start the application. The MSc personal statement should cover why this programme, your background or interest in design, art and information visualisation, your programming skills, and a deep awareness of the social implications of new technologies.

How much are fees and living costs, and what English score do you need?

Official 2027/8 fee lookup: MSc and MA both £18,900 (Scotland), £18,900 (rest of UK) and £47,680 (International/EU) for the year. Edinburgh graduates get a 10% tuition discount. The university estimates average postgraduate living costs in Edinburgh for 2026–2027 at £18,504 a year (£1,542 a month). English tests (IELTS, TOEFL, Oxford ELLT and others) must be no more than two years old on the 1st of the month your programme starts; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. MSc: IELTS Academic 7.0 with 6.5 in three components and 6.0 in the fourth; MA: 7.0 with 6.0 in each.

Where do you study, and what do graduates do?

The MSc page says the programme is based around the Design Informatics studio in the Bayes Centre, with a 3D printer, hacklab, soldering points and Arduinos, plus access to ECA metal and wood workshops; the Informatics teaching building, Appleton Tower, has more than 200 high-spec machines. The MA page mentions the Institute’s Inspace gallery and digital fabrication workshops (laser cutting, 3D printing), and notes ECA’s Lauriston Campus redevelopment is due to finish in April 2027. MSc courses may involve partners such as TravelTech Scotland, the National Library, Edinburgh City Council and the National Museum of Scotland; the MA runs an annual field trip.

Recent graduate job titles listed include UX Designer, Product Manager, System Analyst, AI Engineer, Research Consultant and Senior Software Engineer; others start businesses or go on to a PhD.

Who is this master’s for?

It suits people who want data, code and physical making inside their design work: design or architecture graduates who want computing and data skills should choose the MA; computing, engineering, psychology or linguistics graduates who want design methods and speculative practice should choose the MSc. If you only want to polish screen interfaces and do not want to code or build prototypes, the pace may not suit you. Strong applications explain clearly why data × design × society, and prove with past projects that you can make things.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants check official figures, pick the right MA/MSc route and shape their project stories—always re-check the University of Edinburgh’s live pages when you submit.

q.zh-Hant: 愛丁堡 Design Informatics 碩士讀多久？MSc 和 MA 有什麼不同？
q.en: How long is Edinburgh’s Design Informatics master’s, and how do the MSc and MA differ?

a.zh-Hant: 都是一年全日制、2027 年 9 月開課、180 學分，兩者同屆一起上大部分核心課。MSc 由資訊學院招生，要求資工、工程、心理、語言學等背景並證明程式能力；MA 由 ECA 招生，適合設計、科技或運算相關背景，選修學分較多（40 vs 20）。
a.en: Both are one year full-time, starting September 2027, 180 credits, and share most core courses as one cohort. The MSc (School of Informatics) requires a computing, engineering, psychology, linguistics or similar background plus programming evidence; the MA (ECA) suits design, technology or computing backgrounds and has more option credits (40 vs 20).

q.zh-Hant: 2027 學費多少？
q.en: What are the 2027 tuition fees?

a.zh-Hant: 官方學費查詢頁 2027/8：MSc 與 MA 相同，蘇格蘭及英國其他地區 £18,900、國際／歐盟 £47,680（一年）。另估生活費約 £18,504／年（2026–2027 估算）。MSc 錄取後需繳 £1,500 訂金，MA 不需訂金。
a.en: Official 2027/8 fee lookup: same for MSc and MA—£18,900 (Scotland and rest of UK) and £47,680 (International/EU) for the year. Estimated living costs are about £18,504 a year (2026–2027 estimate). MSc offer-holders pay a £1,500 deposit; the MA needs no deposit.

q.zh-Hant: 雅思要多少？
q.en: What IELTS score do I need?

a.zh-Hant: MSc：IELTS Academic 總分 7.0，三項 6.5、另一項 6.0。MA：總分 7.0，各項 6.0。成績須在開課當月 1 日前兩年內，不接受 One Skill Retake。
a.en: MSc: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 6.5 in three components and 6.0 in the fourth. MA: 7.0 overall with 6.0 in each. Scores must be no more than two years old on the 1st of the month the programme starts; One Skill Retake is not accepted.

q.zh-Hant: 申請截止日是什麼時候？
q.en: When are the application deadlines?

a.zh-Hant: MSc：第一輪 3 月 31 日、第二輪 5 月 31 日（2027 入學版 Degree Finder）。MA：第一輪 2026 年 12 月 14 日、第二輪 2027 年 5 月 31 日。名額滿可能提前關閉，建議第一輪送件。
a.en: MSc: Round 1 on 31 March and Round 2 on 31 May (2027-entry Degree Finder). MA: Round 1 on 14 December 2026 and Round 2 on 31 May 2027. Applications may close early if demand is high, so aim for Round 1.

q.zh-Hant: 需要作品集嗎？
q.en: Do I need a portfolio?

a.zh-Hant: 兩個 Degree Finder 頁面列出的申請文件是個人陳述、相關知識／技能說明、學歷證明、英語證明等，並未把作品集列為必繳；完整清單以開始申請後系統顯示為準。MSc 必須提出程式能力證明（MOOC 證書或已通過的程式課）。
a.en: Both Degree Finder pages list a personal statement, relevant knowledge/skills, transcripts and English evidence, but do not list a portfolio as required; the full checklist appears once you start the application. The MSc requires programming evidence (a MOOC certificate or a passed programming course).

q.zh-Hant: 設計或建築背景可以申請嗎？
q.en: Can I apply with a design or architecture background?

a.zh-Hant: 可以，但官網建議數位設計、工業設計、藝術、建築等背景申請 MA（ECA）；MSc 的科系清單以資工、工程、心理、語言學等為主，且須證明程式能力。
a.en: Yes, but the official page says digital design, industrial design, art and architecture applicants are expected to apply to the MA (ECA); the MSc subject list centres on computing, engineering, psychology, linguistics and similar fields, with programming evidence required.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：米蘭理工大學（Politecnico di Milano）的 MSc Product Service System Design，PSSD，適合想從單一產品或介面，走向產品、服務、數位接觸點與組織協作的人。課程為兩年、英語授課，校區為 Milano Bovisa。海外學歷申請人應看 Architecture and Design 的 2027/28 招生時程：一般輪台北截止為 2027 年 1 月 29 日 06:59（Asia/Taipei）；早鳥台北截止為 2026 年 12 月 2 日 06:59（Asia/Taipei）。作品集上限 20 MB，IELTS Academic 或 General Training 總分至少 6。學費只能寫：以 2026/27 最高級距 €3,883.04 為參考；2027/28 尚未公布。

本文於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照官方資料整理。海外學歷申請文件頁的英語表已標 2027/2028；但課程介紹頁仍提醒內容為 2025/26，之後可能調整，不能把既有課綱稱作已定案的 2027/28 版本。招生、語言與學費的年度必須分開看。

封面為米蘭理工 Bovisa La Masa 校園建築，是大學校園環境示意，並非 PSSD 專屬教室或設計學院授課樓的證明。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Politecnico di Milano Bovisa 6.jpg，Neq00，CC BY-SA 4.0；縮圖）。

PSSD 學什麼？和一般產品設計、UX 有何不同？

依官方課程介紹，PSSD 把產品服務系統理解為產品、服務、溝通、實體物件與數位空間的組合。要處理的不是只有「這個畫面好不好用」，而是使用者如何開始接觸服務、誰提供資源、不同環節如何配合，以及整套方案能否持續運作。教學方法包括民族誌研究、參與式設計與資料導向設計，強調跨領域團隊協作。

現有課綱說明由產品的微觀尺度，逐步走向服務系統與空間，再擴展到更複雜的服務及社會系統。理論部分涵蓋文化與商業情境、使用者經驗、數位創新、服務設計、資料導向方法與永續系統設計。這是用來理解課程方向，不代表下一屆每一門課都已確定。

選校判斷：如果你只想精修視覺介面，PSSD 的系統與組織問題可能比你預期更重；若你希望把 UX 研究、實體產品、服務流程和商業可行性接起來，這個方向更值得比較。這是選校分析，不是校方保證的學習成果或就業承諾。

台灣或其他海外學歷申請人，該看哪一套規則？

官方課程頁對非義大利學歷的說明是：設計學士背景，或具相關畢業後設計工作經驗者可以提出申請，仍須通過個別準備程度及語言能力審查。這不是「任何背景都保證能錄取」。請再對照海外學歷的國別要求、資格是否能銜接碩士，以及適用的最低 CGPA。

不要把義大利學歷規則直接搬過來。課程頁的 23/30、25/30 是義大利學歷相關門檻，本文不把它當作台灣學歷的要求。設計學院的義大利學歷指南，也不能取代海外申請文件清單。以下文件規格優先依foreign-qualification 文件頁整理；如遇版本或申請系統差異，以申請當下指南為準。

作品集、CV 與動機信要怎麼準備？

  • 作品集：Design 申請必繳，PDF 不得超過 20 MB。應呈現過往學習或工作中的代表作品，清楚說明個人觀點、設計與技術能力。非設計背景可用畢業論文摘要及／或課內外實習經驗報告替代；「可替代」不等於自動符合課程背景要求。
  • CV：必繳，最多 2 頁。
  • 學歷文件：學位或適用的在學證明、成績單、累計 GPA 與評分尺度等，依官方清單及國別要求準備。原文非校方接受的語言時，須辦妥官方翻譯要求。
  • 動機信：海外文件頁列在 Optional documents，不是本文自行增列的必繳文件。每個申請課程一封，每封最多 2 頁；若申請兩個課程，兩封合併為同一 PDF。不要套用舊義大利學歷指南的「1 頁／2500 字元」當海外申請強制規定。

作品集怎麼對準 PSSD？建議不要只排最後的漂亮畫面。以一個項目說明：研究發現了什麼矛盾、涉及哪些角色、你如何把洞察轉成產品與服務的關係、如何測試原型，以及迭代後改了什麼。把個人負責部分與團隊成果分清楚。這是編輯建議，不是校方新增的頁數或項目數規定；本文不編造作品集頁數上限。

官方提醒：繳交申請費後，不能再修改或新增已上傳文件。請先檢查 PDF 可讀性、姓名與學歷資料的一致性，再進入付款步驟。

2027 入學何時截止？早鳥和三月加開差在哪？

官方 Architecture and Design 2027/28 時程一般輪自 2026 年 10 月 1 日開放。為避免跨日誤會，以下截止時間均換算為台北時間；官方原表使用 CET。

  • 早鳥：台北 2026 年 12 月 2 日 06:59（Asia/Taipei）截止。官方 10 月 1 日至 12 月 1 日的 early-bird 費率為 €50。
  • 一般輪：台北 2027 年 1 月 29 日 06:59（Asia/Taipei）截止。官方自 12 月 2 日起的 standard 費率為 €150。
  • 結果：官方寫 2027 年 5 月底前，非保證每人同一天收到通知。
  • 三月加開：官方 2027 年 3 月 1 日至 18 日；截止換算為台北 2027 年 3 月 19 日 06:59（Asia/Taipei）。僅限 EEA，以及已在義大利且持符合規定居留身分的非 EEA 申請人；一般居住海外的非 EEA 申請人不能把這一輪當作延後送件的備案。

Architecture and Design 只在第一學期招生。不要把 Engineering 的其他申請輪次套在 PSSD。建議提前完成文件與付款；這不代表早鳥必然錄取，本文不引用課程網站動態計數器當錄取率。

英語要幾分？EMI 可以豁免嗎？

優先依已標 2027/2028 的海外學歷文件頁：

  • IELTS Academic 或 General Training：總分 ≥6。
  • TOEFL Internet Based／Home Edition：2026 年 1 月 20 日或之前考試，總分 ≥78；2026 年 1 月 21 日起考試，總分 ≥4.5。不能把新舊量尺混成一個分數要求。
  • TOEIC：2027/28 起，Listening & Reading ≥785，且 Speaking & Writing ≥310。
  • 學士英語授課豁免：同一官方文件頁明列至少三年的英語授課學士背景，且須由大學出具證明，確認至少 75% 課程以英語授課。不是只寫「全英語」就一定獲准；請按校方證明及審核要求辦理。

一般在校生語言要求頁仍標 2026/2027；本文不把該頁當作上述 EMI 豁免的來源。海外文件頁說，語言證書可在申請截止後補交，但取得 admission letter、參與 merit-based scholarships、簽證與註冊仍需要證明。請另查語言補件期限，不要以為可以無限期延後。校方不接受發證機構已認定過期的證書。

學費怎麼抓？能直接把 €3,883.04 當 2027 費用嗎？

不能。以 2026/27 最高級距 €3,883.04 為參考；2027/28 尚未公布。今日核對的官方學費 PDF明標 2026/2027，並說費用隨修讀學分變動；海外非歐盟學生通常適用最高級距，獎學金持有者另依規定。不要把舊年度金額包裝成下一屆固定學費，也不要把兩年總預算簡化成學費乘二。

做預算時，還應另列住宿、生活、交通、簽證與保險，以及可能的製作材料支出。本文未取得下一年度的完整費用表，因此不提供看似精準卻缺乏依據的總額；申請費與學費也應分開計算。

怎樣判斷自己適不適合？

先問自己：我是否願意在介面以外，追問服務由誰執行、流程在哪裡中斷、不同角色的需求如何取捨？若你的作品只有精修視覺，先補強研究、角色關係與原型驗證的證據；若已有工作經驗，就把真實限制、協作衝突與實際改變說清楚。這些準備比追逐未經查證的錄取率更有用。

我們以12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的經驗，協助申請者梳理選校判斷與項目敘事；不保證錄取，也不代替校方判定資格。下一步是核對國別學歷要求、整理可讀的作品集與文件，再於適用輪次完成送件。
body.en:
Bottom line: Politecnico di Milano’s MSc Product Service System Design (PSSD) suits applicants moving beyond a single product or screen towards the relationship between products, services, digital touchpoints and organisations. It is a two-year, English-taught programme at Milano Bovisa. The Architecture and Design general-call deadline for 2027/28 is 29 January 2027 at 06:59 Asia/Taipei; the early-bird deadline is 2 December 2026 at 06:59 Asia/Taipei. Design portfolios must not exceed 20 MB, and IELTS Academic or General Training requires at least 6 overall. Use the 2026/27 highest bracket of €3,883.04 as a reference only; 2027/28 tuition has not been published.

Checked on 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei). The English-test table on the foreign-qualification documents page is labelled 2027/2028, while the programme page still warns that its description refers to 2025/26 and may change. Do not describe that syllabus as a confirmed 2027/28 curriculum.

The cover shows Bovisa La Masa campus architecture, not evidence of a dedicated PSSD classroom or the programme’s teaching building. Image: Wikimedia Commons（Politecnico di Milano Bovisa 6.jpg，Neq00，CC BY-SA 4.0；resized）.

What does PSSD teach beyond product design or UX?

The official description treats a product-service system as a combination of products, services, communication, artefacts and digital spaces. Methods include ethnographic research, participatory design and data-driven design, with multidisciplinary teamwork. Existing studios progress from product-scale problems to service and spatial systems, then more complex service and social systems. Theory covers cultural and business contexts, user experience, digital innovation, service design and systemic design for sustainability. These describe the current direction, not a guaranteed future module list.

Our interpretation: if you only want to polish visual interfaces, the focus on systems and organisations may feel broader than expected. If you want to connect UX research, physical products, service delivery and business feasibility, it merits comparison. This is editorial guidance, not a university promise of outcomes or employment.

Which admission rules apply to an overseas degree?

The programme page says applicants with a design bachelor’s degree or relevant post-graduation design work experience may apply, subject to assessment and English proficiency. This does not guarantee eligibility for every background. Check country-specific qualification and CGPA requirements separately. Do not apply the Italian-degree averages of 23/30 or 25/30 to Taiwanese qualifications.

Use the foreign-qualification document list, not an older guide for Italian-degree applicants. Follow the guide and application-system requirements in force when applying.

What portfolio, CV and motivation letter should you prepare?

  • Portfolio: mandatory for Design applications, PDF no larger than 20 MB. Show selected educational or professional work, your interests, design and technical skills, and communicate clearly. Non-design applicants may substitute a thesis abstract and/or report on curricular or extracurricular internships; this does not automatically establish programme eligibility.
  • CV: mandatory, maximum two pages.
  • Academic records: qualification or appropriate enrolment evidence, transcript, cumulative GPA and grading scale, with translations as required by the official list and country rules.
  • Motivation letter: listed under Optional documents for foreign qualifications. One letter per selected programme, maximum two pages each; for two applications, combine both letters into one PDF. Do not impose the older Italian-degree guide’s one-page/2,500-character rule on overseas applicants.

Editorial portfolio advice: show the research problem, actors, connection between products and service delivery, prototype tests and resulting changes. Separate personal contributions from team output. This is not an invented university page or project-count requirement. The official list warns that documents cannot be changed or added after paying the application fee, so check readability and consistency first.

When are the 2027 deadlines, and who can use the additional call?

Per the Architecture and Design 2027/28 timetable, the general call opens on 1 October 2026. Deadline clock times below are converted to Asia/Taipei from the official CET table.

  • Early bird: 2 December 2026 at 06:59 Asia/Taipei. The €50 rate applies during the official 1 October–1 December period.
  • General-call deadline: 29 January 2027 at 06:59 Asia/Taipei. The standard application fee is €150 from the official 2 December date.
  • Outcomes: by the end of May 2027, not necessarily on one common day.
  • Additional call: official application period 1–18 March 2027, closing at 06:59 Asia/Taipei on 19 March 2027. Only EEA applicants and non-EEA applicants already resident in Italy with qualifying status can use it. It is not a fallback for typical overseas non-EEA applicants.

Architecture and Design admits in the first semester only. Do not borrow Engineering call dates. Early submission is sensible but does not guarantee admission; this article does not use animated counters as acceptance-rate evidence.

What English scores are accepted, and can an English-medium degree qualify?

The foreign-qualification documents page labels its accepted certificates for 2027/2028:

  • IELTS Academic or General Training: overall ≥6.
  • TOEFL Internet Based / Home Edition: tests taken on or before 20 January 2026 require ≥78 overall; tests from 21 January 2026 require ≥4.5 overall. Keep the old and new scales distinct.
  • TOEIC from 2027/28: Listening & Reading ≥785 and Speaking & Writing ≥310.
  • English-medium bachelor’s exemption: at least three years, with university-certified evidence that at least 75% of the programme’s courses were taught in English. A casual claim of English-medium study is not sufficient; follow the university’s evidence and assessment rules.

The general student language page still says 2026/2027 and is not the cited source for that exemption. A language certificate can be supplied after the application deadline, but it remains mandatory for the admission letter, merit-based scholarships, visa and enrolment. Check the separate certificate submission deadline; this is not an unlimited extension. Certificates considered expired by their issuer are not accepted.

Can €3,883.04 be treated as confirmed 2027 tuition?

No. Use the 2026/27 highest bracket of €3,883.04 as a reference only; 2027/28 tuition has not been published. The official fee PDF is for 2026/2027 and says charges vary with study-plan credits. Overseas non-EU students normally fall into the highest bracket, with scholarship provisions applying separately. Do not present an older figure as the new cohort’s fixed fee or reduce a two-year budget to twice one year’s tuition.

Budget separately for accommodation, living costs, travel, immigration, insurance and possible making materials. This article does not invent a next-year total. Application fees and tuition are distinct.

How should you judge whether it fits?

Ask whether you want to investigate who delivers a service, where a process breaks down and how different actors’ needs are balanced. If your portfolio is mainly polished visuals, add evidence of research, actor relationships and prototype validation. If you have professional experience, explain real constraints, collaboration and what changed. That is more useful than an unverified acceptance rate.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants clarify school choices and project narratives. We do not guarantee admission or determine eligibility on the university’s behalf. Next, verify country requirements and prepare readable evidence for the appropriate call.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦藝術大學（University of the Arts London, UAL）倫敦傳播學院（London College of Communication, LCC）的 MA Service Design（服務設計碩士），官網標示 2027 年 9 月入學、學費 2027/28 英國本地 £14,710、國際學生 £31,510；英語為 IELTS 6.5、四項各不低於 6.0。申請分兩輪：第一輪 2026 年 12 月 1 日、第二輪 2027 年 2 月 17 日（皆台北 21:00，Asia/Taipei）；初審後通常還要在 PebblePad 交數位作品集與 2–3 分鐘影片。課程長度方面，頁首與「Course length change」公告明寫 2027/28 起由 15 個月改為 12 個月全日制；頁面 Mode of study 段落仍殘留「45 週／15 個月」舊文，送件前請再對一次官網。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 UAL 官方課程頁、碩士申請頁與研究所學費頁查核；學費、截止與單元每年可能調整，送件前請再看 arts.ac.uk。

封面是 LCC 原校舍歷史影像，並非 2027 新大樓。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（259 - Ugly London College Of Communication Building.jpg，Randomly London，CC BY-SA 2.0；裁切、縮圖）

UAL 服務設計碩士學什麼？跟 UX／產品設計差在哪？

官網把服務設計定義為以人為本：在公部門或私部門設計服務、以參與式／迭代／質性方式與利害關係人合作，並同時考慮更大的系統。課程由使用者尺度的現況挑戰，一路推到未來與系統層級；多數項目為 live project，與多個夥伴、客戶、專家與利害關係人一起做。

  • Term 1：User-Centred Project（40 學分）＋ Ways of Working（20）——核心理論、協作、研究與設計創新；偏使用者、現在或近未來。
  • Term 2：Design Futures（20）＋ Collaborative Unit（20）——系統層級、跨領域團隊；Design Futures 用推測設計與 research-through-design 探未來。
  • Term 3–4：Proposal Development（20）＋ Major Project（60）——自訂領域的原創設計研究項目，含利害關係人與共創、測試與多媒介呈現。
  • 學分合計依頁面單元加總為 180；無法讀完可依已修學分取得 Postgraduate Certificate（60）或 Diploma（120）。

和偏螢幕介面優化的 UX 碩士相比，這裡更強調公私部門服務、政策與系統、共創與倫理；官網也寫明重視 making 與設計方法，並用報告、影片、展覽等輸出溝通過程。

申請條件是什麼？要交哪些文件？

  • 學歷／背景：歡迎全球申請者；可有設計相關榮譽學士或其他同等學歷，也歡迎社會科學、商管、產業經驗與非傳統背景；另有 APEL 途徑，個案審查。
  • 英語：課堂全英語；若英語非母語，官網要求 IELTS 6.5（或同等）且四項各至少 6.0。建議在申請與 CV 註明成績或已報考。
  • 選拔重點：對服務設計／體驗設計／創新有理解；願意跨領域混編團隊；能以研究所水準批判反思；並在設計、使用者研究、項目管理、創新或社會企業等至少一項展現技能。
  • 初始申請：個人陳述（最多 500 字）、CV、study proposal（1,000 字：興趣領域、為何值得做、方法與可能產出）。
  • 之後通常還要：經 PebblePad 交 2–3 分鐘影片（選作品集 1 個項目說明如何挑戰你對服務設計的理解，以及為何申請 LCC）＋數位作品集（最多 10 頁、最多 5 個項目，含動機／發展／實現／影響說明；非設計背景可放專業或研究案例）。
  • 面試：書面審後可能邀請線上面試，約 15–20 分鐘。

2027 申請截止日是什麼時候？學費多少？

截止（課程頁）：第一輪申請 2026/12/1 21:00（Asia/Taipei），作品集＋影片 2026/12/15，結果最晚 2027/3/12；第二輪申請 2027/2/17 21:00（Asia/Taipei），作品集＋影片 2027/3/3，結果最晚 2027/5/7。第二輪後若仍有名額可繼續開放。UAL 碩士申請頁另提醒：錯過第一輪作品截止不會自動轉入第二輪，且同一學年同一課程通常只能申請一次。

學費（2027/28）：本地 £14,710、國際 £31,510（課程頁明寫適用 2027/28，之後可能調整；可分期）。材料與設備等額外費用另計。UAL 官方學費總表中，標準費率 45 週 Masters 與上述數字一致。官網碩士申請流程頁未列出申請費，送件時以申請系統顯示為準。

在哪裡上課？畢業後做什麼？

課程在 LCC（Elephant & Castle）；官網寫明你會是新大樓首批學生之一（新址就在現校區對街）。LCC 研究所學期日可能與 UAL 標準學期不同。產業合作例子包括 EU Policy Lab、Lambeth Council、Decathlon、Camden Council 等 live project。

校友職稱舉例：Service Designer、Design Researcher、Experience Designer、Design Strategist、User Centred Consultant、Participatory Designer、UX Designer，以及學術路線；也可繼續攻讀博士。

這個碩士適合誰？

適合想把服務、系統與利害關係人共創當作主要設計媒材的人：設計背景想往策略與公部門／組織服務延伸者，或社會科學、商管、創新背景想補上設計方法者。若你只想優化 App 介面、不願意做現場研究與跨組織協作，節奏可能不合。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、梳理服務設計項目敘事與作品集節奏；任何學費與截止日仍以送件當下的 UAL 官網為準。

版本提醒：12 個月的新結構仍在調整中；現頁單元、學期與 45 週／15 個月敘述未必已同步，請向課程團隊確認新制的實際週數與單元配置。學費總表說所列費用涵蓋整個課程，不是逐學年收費；本課以課程頁 2027/28 標價為準。

UAL 一般作品集指南提醒，影片會占用 PebblePad 頁面配置；請依個人收到的提交要求安排，不要自行假定可在上限之外多加一頁。個人補件截止可能早於課程頁統一最晚日期，以通知為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: University of the Arts London’s London College of Communication (UAL LCC) MA Service Design starts in September 2027. Official 2027/28 tuition is £14,710 Home and £31,510 International; English is IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each skill. Applications run in two rounds: 1 December 2026 and 17 February 2027 (21:00 Asia/Taipei), usually followed by a digital portfolio and a 2–3 minute video on PebblePad. The page header and a “Course length change” notice state the course is moving from 15 months to 12 months full-time for 2027/28 onwards; the Mode of study paragraph still says “45 weeks over 15 months,” so re-check before you apply.

Figures below were checked in 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) against the UAL course page, the postgraduate apply page and the postgraduate tuition-fee tables on arts.ac.uk. Fees, deadlines and units can change—re-check the live site when you submit.

The cover is a historical LCC campus view, not the 2027 new building. Image: Wikimedia Commons（259 - Ugly London College Of Communication Building.jpg，Randomly London，CC BY-SA 2.0；cropped and resized）

What does MA Service Design teach, and how is it different from UX or product design?

UAL frames service design as human-centred work: designing services in the public or private sector, working participatively, iteratively and qualitatively with stakeholders, and considering wider systems. The course moves from local, user-scale challenges toward futures and systems, with most projects live and multi-partner.

  • Term 1: User-Centred Project (40 credits) + Ways of Working (20) — core theory, collaboration, research and design innovation; user focus, present or near future.
  • Term 2: Design Futures (20) + Collaborative Unit (20) — systems-level, multidisciplinary teams; speculative design and research-through-design.
  • Terms 3–4: Proposal Development (20) + Major Project (60) — an original design research project with stakeholders, co-design, testing and multi-media outcomes.
  • Unit credits on the page sum to 180; exit awards PG Cert (60) / PG Dip (120).

Compared with screen-first UX degrees, this MA stresses public and private services, policy and systems, co-design and ethics, with making and designed artefacts used to communicate process.

What are the entry requirements and documents?

  • Background: honours degree in a design-related field or equivalent; social science, business, industry and non-traditional routes welcome; APEL considered case by case.
  • English: IELTS 6.5 (or equivalent) with a minimum of 6.0 in each of the four skills.
  • Selection: understanding of service design / experience design / innovation; openness to cross-disciplinary teams; postgraduate-level critical engagement; skills in design, user research, project management, innovation or social entrepreneurship.
  • Initial application: personal statement (max 500 words), CV, study proposal (1,000 words).
  • Usually next: PebblePad 2–3 minute video (one portfolio project + why this MA at LCC) and digital portfolio (max 10 pages, max 5 projects).
  • Interview: possible online interview, 15–20 minutes.

When are the 2027 deadlines, and what are the fees?

Deadlines (course page): Round 1 apply by 1 Dec 2026, 21:00（Asia/Taipei）, portfolio and video by 15 Dec 2026, outcome by 12 Mar 2027; Round 2 apply by 17 Feb 2027, 21:00（Asia/Taipei）, portfolio and video by 3 Mar 2027, outcome by 7 May 2027. The course may stay open after Round 2 if places remain. UAL’s postgraduate apply page notes that missing a Round 1 portfolio deadline does not move you to Round 2, and you normally apply once per course per academic year.

Fees (2027/28): £14,710 Home, £31,510 International (correct for 2027/28; may change later; instalments available). Extra materials/equipment are not included. These match UAL’s standard-rate 45-week Masters band for 2027/28. The postgraduate apply pages do not list an application fee; treat the live application portal as authoritative if a charge appears.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦藝術大學（UAL）倫敦傳播學院（LCC）目前官網上的 UX 設計碩士正式名稱是 MA User Experience Design（使用者體驗設計碩士）——不是 MA Interaction Design，也不是舊稱式的「Interaction Design Communication」。課程2027 年 9 月入學；2027/28 學費本地 £14,710、國際 £31,510；英語 IELTS 6.5、四項各 6.0。兩輪截止2026/12/1與2027/2/17（皆台北 21:00，Asia/Taipei），之後通常還要交作品集與影片。頁首公告明寫2027/28 起由 15 個月改為 12 個月全日制；Mode of study 仍殘留 15 個月舊文，送件前請再核對。

以下於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 UAL 官方課程頁、碩士申請頁與學費總表查核；數字每年可能調整，送件前請再看 arts.ac.uk。

封面是 LCC 原校舍歷史影像，並非 2027 新大樓。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（LCC2025.jpg，SophiaNasif，CC BY-SA 4.0；裁切、縮圖）

MA User Experience Design 學什麼？跟 Interaction Design 差在哪？

官網定位為產業導向、設計主導：學習如何構想、原型與產出互動數位情境中的以人為本體驗；工作室實踐為核心，同時涵蓋使用者研究與批判理論。強調複雜系統、新興科技與整合體驗，並「超越螢幕」——研究、互動設計、原型、概念發展與評估。

  • UX Studio Practices（40 學分）：把個人實踐對位當代 UX 理論與工作室方法，覺察身體／個人／社會脈絡如何形塑設計。
  • Macro UX（20）＋ Collaborative Unit（20）：與外部夥伴做 live brief（主題例：智慧城市、文化地方營造、出版未來、檔案與收藏等）；Collaborative Unit 組建跨校／外部協作關係。
  • Micro UX（40）：再與不同外部組織合作（主題例：健康福祉、資料視覺化、人機協作、表演與公眾參與），依 Macro UX 建立的研究旅程深化項目。
  • Final Major Project and Portfolio of Writing（60）：研究主導的個人畢業項目與寫作組合。

單元學分加總為 180。與同校 MA Interaction Design（偏批判／推測／實體運算與媒體藝術理論）相比，本課更明確對準專業 UX 工作室技能與產業 live brief；兩者申請材料與選拔敘事也不同，請分開準備，勿混投。

申請條件是什麼？作品集要什麼？

  • 背景：歡迎開放、好問的申請者；常見本科含平面／互動／互動媒體／網頁／傳達設計、資工、數位設計、產品設計、人類學、社會學等；也歡迎產業回流與 APEL。
  • 作品集期待：官網明寫申請者「will have a portfolio of digital design work」展現 UX 的創意與批判面向；也可來自平面、資訊或互動設計等鄰近職涯。
  • 英語：IELTS 6.5（或同等），四項各 6.0。建議申請時註明成績；CV 可附上英語分數。
  • 初始申請：個人陳述（最多 500 字）、CV、study proposal（300–500 字：興趣領域、焦點與方法）。
  • 之後通常還要：PebblePad 上 2–3 分鐘影片（選 1 個項目說明如何挑戰你對 UX 的理解，以及為何申請本課）＋數位作品集（最多 20 頁，含影片頁；最多 5 個項目；要含過程草圖／測試；非設計背景請附研究主題說明）。
  • 面試：可能線上 15–20 分鐘。

2027 截止日與學費是多少？

截止：第一輪申請 2026/12/1 21:00（Asia/Taipei），作品集＋影片 2026/12/15，結果 2027/3/12；第二輪申請 2027/2/17 21:00（Asia/Taipei），作品集＋影片 2027/3/3，結果 2027/5/7。名額未滿時第二輪後可繼續開放。錯過第一輪作品截止不會轉入第二輪。

學費 2027/28：本地 £14,710、國際 £31,510（之後可能調整；可分期）。與 UAL 學費總表標準費率一致。碩士申請頁未列出申請費。

產業合作與畢業去向？

Why-choose 區塊提到近期夥伴如 R/GA、UCL、Kinda Studios；Macro／Micro UX 以 live brief 對接產業或第三部門。職涯選項官網列出：User Researcher、Interaction Designer、Experience Designer、Digital Director、Interface Designer；也可進入公部門（如 GDS）或非營利組織。

上課地點為 LCC Elephant & Castle，並將成為新大樓首批學生之一；LCC 研究所學期日可能與 UAL 標準不同。

這個碩士適合誰？

適合想深耕設計主導的 UX、願意做使用者研究與批判反思，並接受 live brief 協作者。若你更想走批判互動藝術、推測設計與實體運算實驗，應改看同校 MA Interaction Design。兩條路線是不同課程，作品集、提案與選拔敘事應分別準備。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者核對官網數字、區分 UX 與 Interaction Design 路線並整理項目敘事；學費與截止日仍以送件當下 UAL 官網為準。

版本提醒：12 個月的新結構仍在調整中；現頁單元、學期與 45 週／15 個月敘述未必已同步，請向課程團隊確認新制的實際週數與單元配置。學費總表說所列費用涵蓋整個課程，不是逐學年收費；本課以課程頁 2027/28 標價為準。

UAL 一般作品集指南提醒，影片會占用 PebblePad 頁面配置；請依個人收到的提交要求安排，不要自行假定可在上限之外多加一頁。個人補件截止可能早於課程頁統一最晚日期，以通知為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: The current UX master’s on the UAL site at London College of Communication is officially titled MA User Experience Design—not MA Interaction Design, and not an “Interaction Design Communication” rename. It starts in September 2027; 2027/28 fees are £14,710 Home and £31,510 International; English is IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each skill. Deadlines are 1 December 2026 and 17 February 2027 (21:00 Asia/Taipei), usually followed by portfolio and video. The banner states a move from 15 months to 12 months full-time for 2027/28; Mode of study still says 15 months—re-check before applying.

Figures were checked in 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) on arts.ac.uk course, apply and fee pages. Re-check before you submit.

The cover is a historical LCC campus view, not the 2027 new building. Image: Wikimedia Commons（LCC2025.jpg，SophiaNasif，CC BY-SA 4.0；cropped and resized）

What does MA User Experience Design teach, and how does it differ from Interaction Design?

UAL positions the course as industry-focused and design-led: conceiving, prototyping and producing human-centred experiences in interactive digital contexts, with studio practice at the centre and user research plus critical theory throughout. It stresses complex systems, emerging technologies and integrated experiences, and skills that go “beyond screens.”

  • UX Studio Practices (40 credits) — locate your practice against contemporary UX theory and studio methods.
  • Macro UX (20) + Collaborative Unit (20) — live briefs with external partners; themes such as smart cities, cultural placemaking, futures of publishing, archives and collections.
  • Micro UX (40) — a second external collaboration (e.g. health and wellbeing, data visualisation, human–robot relations, performance and public participation).
  • Final Major Project and Portfolio of Writing (60) — research-led individual major project.

Unit credits sum to 180. Compared with LCC’s MA Interaction Design (more critical / speculative / physical computing and media-art theory), this MA targets professional UX studio skills and industry live briefs. Prepare separate applications; do not mix the two narratives.

What are the entry requirements and portfolio rules?

  • Background: open, inquiring applicants from graphic / interaction / interactive media / web / communication design, computer science, digital or product design, anthropology, sociology and related fields; industry returners and APEL welcome.
  • Portfolio expectation: the page states applicants “will have a portfolio of digital design work” showing creative and critical aspects of UX; adjacent careers (graphic, information, interaction design) are anticipated.
  • English: IELTS 6.5 (or equivalent), with 6.0 in each of the four skills.
  • Initial application: personal statement (max 500 words), CV, study proposal (300–500 words).
  • Usually next: PebblePad 2–3 minute video plus digital portfolio (max 20 pages including the video page; up to 5 projects; include process work).
  • Interview: possible online, 15–20 minutes.

When are the 2027 deadlines, and what are the fees?

Deadlines: Round 1 apply 1 Dec 2026, 21:00（Asia/Taipei）, portfolio and video 15 Dec 2026, outcome 12 Mar 2027; Round 2 apply 17 Feb 2027, 21:00（Asia/Taipei）, portfolio and video 3 Mar 2027, outcome 7 May 2027. May remain open after Round 2 if places remain. Missing a Round 1 portfolio deadline does not move you to Round 2.

Fees 2027/28: £14,710 Home, £31,510 International (subject to later change; instalments available). Matches UAL’s standard-rate Masters band. Postgraduate apply pages do not list an application fee.

Industry partners and careers?

Why-choose cites recent partners such as R/GA, UCL and Kinda Studios; Macro/Micro UX use live briefs with industry or third-sector organisations. Career options listed: User Researcher, Interaction Designer, Experience Designer, Digital Director, Interface Designer; also public organisations (e.g. GDS) and non-profits.

You study at LCC Elephant & Castle and are among the first students in the new building; LCC postgraduate term dates may differ from standard UAL dates.

Who is this master’s for?

It suits applicants who want design-led UX, user research and critical reflection, and who are ready for live briefs. If you prefer critical interactive art, speculative design and physical-computing experiments, look instead at LCC’s MA Interaction Design. They are separate courses: prepare each portfolio, proposal and selection narrative independently.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants verify official figures, choose between UX and Interaction Design routes, and shape project stories—always re-check UAL’s live pages when you submit.

Version caveat: the new 12-month structure is still being developed; listed units, terms and the 45-week/15-month copy may not yet be aligned. Confirm the new weekly schedule and module configuration with the team. The fee table says listed fees cover the whole course rather than each academic year; use this course’s 2027/28 price.

UAL’s general guidance says the video occupies a PebblePad page allocation; follow your individual request rather than assuming an extra page beyond the cap. Your personal document deadline may be earlier than the course-wide latest date.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦藝術大學中央聖馬丁學院（Central Saint Martins, CSM）的 MA Applied Imagination（應用想像力碩士）是 Creative Enterprise programme 下的非學科邊界、學生中心一年制碩士：45 週／12 個月全日制、180 學分、2027 年 1 月入學。學費官網寫明適用 January 2027：本地 £14,420、國際 £30,890；英語 IELTS 6.5、四項各至少 5.5。與多數 UAL 九月入學、兩輪截止的碩士不同，本課頁首為 Open for applications，並寫明額滿前持續開放（2026 年 11 月 8 日查核時仍開放）；表格仍可見 2026/10/21 標記，但不應解讀成已關窗。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 UAL／CSM 官方課程頁與碩士申請／學費頁查核；一月班學費與九月班標準費率不同，送件前請再看官網。

封面是中央聖馬丁 King’s Cross 建築立面。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Central Saint Martins College of Arts and Design King's Cross.jpg，Kh csm，CC BY-SA 3.0；裁切、縮圖）

Applied Imagination 學什麼？為什麼叫「應用想像力」？

官網說這門課給想走出可預測路徑的人：培養 problem-finder 與 change-maker，用想像力質問創意學科中的既有假設。課程承認當代全球挑戰的跨學科本質，學生做自主研究旅程、建立外部網絡，並用行動研究與介入去驗證想法。

  • Unit 1 Imagination：短週期個人／小組項目，質問當代全球議題（社會正義、氣候、健康福祉、身分與科技等），拆解對改變的抗拒；單元末起草研究提案。
  • Unit 2 Collaborative Unit：嵌在 Unit 1 內，與其他研究所課程學生跨界協作。
  • Unit 3 Application：把提案發展成可行項目，建立利害關係人網絡與外部驗證，體現行動研究倫理。
  • Unit 4 Applied Imagination：完成外部驗證、反思學習，並以合適形式呈現成果供評量。

學分 180；無法讀完可取 PG Cert（60）或 PG Dip（120）；學位等第主要依最後一單元成績。每週約 40 小時（含教學與自修）。

申請條件是什麼？真的不用作品集嗎？

  • 學歷：榮譽學士或同等歐盟／國際學歷；例外可走 AP(E)L，依相關經驗、陳述與推薦等綜合判斷，不保證錄取。
  • 背景：歡迎任何創意學科背景——設計、純藝、表演、策展與藝術商業、新聞、廣告行銷、管理、經濟，以及科學與科技；重視勇氣、自我驅動與跨界協作意願。
  • 英語：IELTS 6.5，聽／讀／寫／說各至少 5.5。
  • 文件：初始申請只要個人陳述（最多 500 字）＋ CV；通過初審後交 2–3 分鐘影片（英語、面對鏡頭：創造力如何讓世界更好、本課如何幫助你；可插入圖像但須保持出鏡）。
  • 作品集：課程「How to apply」步驟未要求數位作品集（與 LCC 多數設計碩士不同）。若之後系統另有要求，以申請當下指示為準。
  • 面試：可能線上 15–20 分鐘。

截止與學費：一月班數字一樣嗎？

申請節奏：頁首為開放申請；影片通常在收到要求後 7 天內提交；決定約在申請後 6 週。頁面表格仍列出 2026 年 10 月 21 日標記，但同一頁多次寫「仍開放至額滿」——2026-11-08 查核時課程仍開放。建議盡早送件，勿假設九月班那套 12/1、2/17 兩輪制自動適用。

學費（January 2027）：本地 £14,420、國際 £30,890（官網寫明適用 2027 年 1 月入學，2028 年 1 月可能調整；可分期）。這組數字低於多數 LCC 2027/28 九月班標準費率（£14,710／£31,510），請勿混用。碩士申請頁未列出申請費。

畢業後做什麼？適合誰？

Why-choose 強調職涯如 Innovation Consultant、Entrepreneur、Creative Director、Strategic Planner、Creative Consultant。校友分布極廣——表演、建築、廣播、創意管理、創業、電影、發明、新聞、音樂、社會創新、網頁設計、學術與博士等；也曾回到廣告、策展、展場與博物館設計、影視、時尚、平面、行銷、產品、公關、出版等領域。

適合已有創作／專業基礎、想用跨界行動研究把自己的問題做成可驗證改變的人；不適合只想跟著固定設計工作室 brief、不願自主定義研究問題的申請者。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者核對一月班學費與滾動時程、打磨影片與陳述中的改變敘事；任何數字仍以送件當下 UAL 官網為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: Central Saint Martins’ MA Applied Imagination, part of the Creative Enterprise programme, is a non-disciplinary, student-centred one-year MA: 45 weeks / 12 months full-time, 180 credits, starting January 2027. Fees stated for January 2027 are £14,420 Home and £30,890 International; English is IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each skill. Unlike most UAL September master’s with two fixed rounds, the course header says Open for applications and remains open until places are filled (still open when checked on 8 November 2026). A 21 October 2026 marker still appears in the table—do not treat that as a hard closed window while the page says places remain.

Figures were checked in 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) on the official CSM course page and UAL apply/fee pages. January-intake fees differ from September 2027/28 standard bands—re-check before you submit.

The cover shows a building façade at Central Saint Martins King’s Cross. Image: Wikimedia Commons（Central Saint Martins College of Arts and Design King's Cross.jpg，Kh csm，CC BY-SA 3.0；cropped and resized）

What does Applied Imagination teach, and why that name?

UAL describes the course for people who want to move beyond the predictable: become a problem-finder and change-maker, apply imagination, and question assumptions in the creative disciplines. Students run self-directed research journeys, build external networks, and test ideas through action research and interventions.

  • Unit 1 Imagination — short individual and team projects that interrogate global agendas and resistances to change; ends with a draft research proposal.
  • Unit 2 Collaborative Unit — nested in Unit 1; cross-course postgraduate collaboration.
  • Unit 3 Application — develop the proposal into a viable project with stakeholder networks and external verification.
  • Unit 4 Applied Imagination — complete verification, reflect, and present outcomes for assessment.

180 credits; exit awards PG Cert (60) / PG Dip (120); award classification from the final unit only. Expect about 40 hours a week including independent study.

What are the entry requirements—and is a portfolio required?

  • Academic: an honours degree or equivalent EU/international qualification; exceptional AP(E)L cases considered; no guaranteed offer.
  • Background: any creative discipline—design, fine art, performance, curation and art business, journalism, advertising and marketing, management, economics, science and technology—plus courage and self-direction.
  • English: IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in reading, writing, listening and speaking.
  • Documents: initial application is personal statement (max 500 words) + CV; then a 2–3 minute video on how creativity can make the world better and how this course helps.
  • Portfolio: the How-to-apply steps do not list a digital portfolio (unlike most LCC design master’s). If the portal later asks for one, follow the live instructions.
  • Interview: possible online, 15–20 minutes.

Deadlines and fees for the January intake

Timing: open until places are filled; video usually due 7 days after the request; decision about 6 weeks from application. The table still shows a 21 October 2026 marker, but the same page repeatedly says the course remains open—as of 8 November 2026 it was still open. Apply early; do not assume the September two-round calendar (1 Dec / 17 Feb) automatically applies.

Fees (January 2027): £14,420 Home, £30,890 International (correct for January 2027; may change for January 2028; instalments available). These figures are lower than many LCC September 2027/28 standard-rate fees (£14,710 / £31,510)—do not mix them. Postgraduate apply pages do not list an application fee.

Careers and who it suits

Why-choose highlights roles such as Innovation Consultant, Entrepreneur, Creative Director, Strategic Planner and Creative Consultant. Alumni appear across almost every part of the creative sector—and in academic/PhD routes.

It suits people with a creative or professional base who want to turn their own questions into testable change via action research. It is a poor fit if you only want fixed studio briefs and are unwilling to define your own research agenda.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants verify January-intake fees and rolling timelines, and sharpen change narratives in the video and statement—always re-check UAL’s live pages when you submit.

title.zh-Hant: 拉夫堡大學 User Experience Design 碩士怎麼申請？MA／MSc 怎麼選、國際學費 £32,750、雅思 6.5、2027 入學（2026 年 11 月官網查核）
title.en: How do you apply to Loughborough’s User Experience Design master’s? MA vs MSc, £32,750 international fees, IELTS 6.5 and 2027 entry (checked November 2026)

summary.zh-Hant: 拉夫堡大學 User Experience Design：MA／MSc 兩種學位、同一課程主幹；一年全日制（亦可兼讀）、2027/9 開課、180 學分；2027-28 學費英國 £14,000、國際 £32,750；雅思標準 6.5（各項 6.0）；國際申請最晚約 2027/8/23（作品集課程建議不晚於 8/13）；設計背景需約 10 頁作品集；免申請費。
summary.en: Loughborough User Experience Design: MA or MSc award on one programme spine; one year full-time (part-time available) from September 2027, 180 credits; 2027-28 fees £14,000 UK / £32,750 international; IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each); international applications by 23 Aug 2027 (portfolio programmes ideally by 13 Aug); ~10-page portfolio for design backgrounds; no application fee.

tldr.zh-Hant: 拉夫堡大學（Loughborough University）School of Design and Creative Arts 的 User Experience Design（MA／MSc） 是設計作品集申請者最對口的單一 UX 碩士：強調用人研究、可用性、原型與 XR／AI 等新興科技做體驗設計；入學後數週可再選 MA 或 MSc 畢業項目路線，也可改讀姊妹課 User Experience and Service Design。一年全日制、2027 年 9 月開課；官網公布 2027-28 學費英國 £14,000、國際 £32,750；英語為大學標準 IELTS 6.5（各項 6.0）；國際生最晚申請 2027 年 8 月 23 日（作品集課建議 8 月 13 日前）；免申請費；設計背景需約 10 頁作品集。
tldr.en: Loughborough’s User Experience Design (MA/MSc) is the best-fit single UX PGT for portfolio applicants: human-centred research, usability, prototyping and emerging tech (XR/AI). After arrival you choose MA vs MSc final-project style and may switch to UX & Service Design. One year full-time from September 2027; published 2027-28 fees £14,000 UK / £32,750 international; standard IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each); international deadline 23 August 2027 (portfolio programmes ideally by 13 August); no application fee; design applicants need ~10-page portfolio.

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：拉夫堡大學的 User Experience Design 碩士以 MA 或 MSc 兩種學位頒發，主幹內容相近，差別主要在畢業項目取向（MSc 偏實證研究與資料分析，MA 偏創意與大方向構想）。官網列一年全日制、2027 年 9 月開課，180 學分。學費頁面標明 Fees for 2027-28：英國 £14,000、國際 £32,750（每年／全日制）。英語採大學標準 IELTS 6.5、各項不少於 6.0（研究所授課學位除 Clinical Exercise Physiology 外皆用此標準）。國際申請最晚 2027 年 8 月 23 日（需作品集者建議不晚於 8 月 13 日）；英國申請最晚 9 月 13 日。免申請費；國際生若需 CAS，訂金 £2,500。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 lboro.ac.uk 課程頁、Design School 申請說明、碩士截止日頁與英語要求頁查核；學費、截止與入學條件每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。

封面為本校校園建築脈絡，並非本課學生作品。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Loughborough Design School.jpg，Zorin90，CC BY-SA 4.0；縮圖）

為什麼選 User Experience Design，而不是 UX & Service Design？

拉夫堡同時開 User Experience Design 與 User Experience and Service Design。前者官網明寫把你培養成 UX 專才（可走 VR、包容設計或 AI 等方向）；後者更偏服務設計、體驗視野較廣。對多數帶設計作品集、目標職稱是 UX／Interaction／Product Design 的申請者，User Experience Design 更對口。官網也說：不確定可先申請較符合的一門，到校後不久仍可改課。

User Experience Design 學什麼？MA 和 MSc 差在哪？

課程強調可就業的人因體驗設計：設計研究方法、可用性、生成／評估原型、影像原型、互動設計、團隊與對客戶溝通、項目管理，並接觸把數位嵌進實體世界、以及 AI／XR 等新機會。結構含 Experience Design、Usability、Understanding People、Industry Project 等模組，暑假完成 60 學分畢業項目。

MA 與 MSc 內容相近，主要差別在最終項目：MSc 走實證調查與資料分析；MA 走創意與大構想。入學後前幾週再決定要攻哪個學位，校方會協助選擇。

2027 申請截止日是什麼時候？要交哪些文件？

校方 Key master’s deadlines 頁的 2027 秋季時程：

  • 國際生：新申請最晚 2027 年 8 月 23 日（須含支援文件）；需作品集或創意寫作的課程審核較久，建議不晚於 8 月 13 日。接受錄取與補件最晚 8 月 30 日；CAS 訂金最晚 8 月 23 日。
  • 英國本地生：新申請最晚 2027 年 9 月 13 日。

熱門課程可能提前額滿、提早停止發 offer，宜盡早送件。設計相關背景須交約 10 頁作品集，展現人因設計流程、成果與對終端使用者的思考；非設計背景可不交作品集，但需有力個人陳述、CV 與成績單，必要時校方會另給小型設計作業。

學費與英語要求是多少？

課程頁 2027-28：英國 £14,000、國際 £32,750（全日制、180 學分基準；兼讀按學分比例）。費用每年檢討，後續年度漲幅不超過 5%（官網說明）。英語：大學標準 IELTS Academic 總分 6.5、聽讀寫說各 6.0；成績通常須在開課時兩年內。線上申請免申請費。

入學條件與適合誰？

英國 2:1 榮譽學士或同等學歷；歡迎藝術與設計、資工、媒體、心理、商學等相關科系。不必先有設計學位，也不必會寫程式，但要對新科技有興趣、能與資料共事。適合想系統學習 UX 研究＋設計實作、並用作品集證明人因思維的申請者。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、釐清 MA／MSc 與作品集敘事；任何學費與截止日仍以送件當下的拉夫堡大學官網為準。

模組頁說明為現行年度示例，下一年度可調整；實際開學日與迎新請依校方通知。英語頁明列授課型研究所除指定例外外採通用標準；未見本設計課程另列較高 IELTS，仍以 offer 條件為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: Loughborough’s User Experience Design master’s is awarded as an MA or MSc on a shared spine; the main difference is the final project (MSc empirical/data-led; MA creative/big-picture). Official page: one year full-time, September 2027 start , 180 credits. Fees for 2027-28: UK £14,000, International £32,750. English: University standard IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each element (all PGT except Clinical Exercise Physiology). International applications by 23 August 2027 (portfolio programmes ideally by 13 August); UK by 13 September 2027. No application fee; CAS deposit £2,500 if a Student visa is needed.

Figures checked on 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) against lboro.ac.uk programme, Design School application, masters deadlines and English-requirements pages. Re-check before you apply.

The cover shows university campus architecture, not student work from this programme. Image: Wikimedia Commons（Loughborough Design School.jpg，Zorin90，CC BY-SA 4.0；resized）

Why User Experience Design rather than UX & Service Design?

Loughborough runs both. UX Design is framed as training UX specialists (e.g. VR, inclusivity, AI routes); UX & Service Design leans broader into service design. For most portfolio applicants aiming at UX/Interaction roles, User Experience Design is the better single pick. The page says you can apply to the closer fit and switch soon after arrival if needed.

What do you study, and how do MA and MSc differ?

The programme targets job-ready human-centred designers: research methods, usability, generative/evaluative and video prototyping, interaction design, teamwork, client skills and project management, plus digital-in-physical experiences and AI/XR opportunities. Modules include Experience Design, Usability, Understanding People and an Industry Project, with a 60-credit summer major project.

MA and MSc content is very similar; the award difference is the final project. You choose after the first few weeks with staff guidance.

When are the 2027 deadlines, and what documents do you need?

For September 2027 programmes: international new applications by 23 August 2027 (portfolio courses ideally by 13 August); UK by 13 September 2027. High-demand courses may close early. Design backgrounds submit ~10-page portfolios showing human-centred process, outcome and end-user thinking; non-design applicants may omit a portfolio but need a strong statement, CV and transcript (a small design task may follow).

How much are fees, and what English score do you need?

2027-28: UK £14,000, International £32,750 full-time. Standard IELTS 6.5 / 6.0 each. No application fee.

Who is this master’s for?

A UK 2:1 or equivalent in art and design, computing, media, psychology, business and related fields. No prior design degree or coding required—curiosity about people and new tech matters. Strong fits want structured UX research-and-design practice and a portfolio that proves human-centred thinking.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants check official figures and shape MA/MSc and portfolio stories—always re-check Loughborough’s live pages when you submit.

Modules are current-year examples and may change. Confirm the exact start and induction dates from university communications. The taught-postgraduate English section applies the standard requirement except for its named exception; no separate higher IELTS for this design course was listed, but follow your offer.

title.en: How do you apply to Goldsmiths’ MA Design: Expanded Practice? 15 months, £30,700 international fees, IELTS 6.5 and two 2027 rounds (checked November 2026)

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：倫敦大學金匠學院（Goldsmiths, University of London）設計學院的 MA Design: Expanded Practice，是把傳統平面／產品／時尚／空間等專長，擴成批判與社會取向「進階設計」的 15 個月全日制碩士。官網公布就讀 2027/2028 學年者學費：Home £14,900、International £30,700。英語 IELTS 6.5（寫作 6.5，其餘不低於 6.0）。申請兩輪：第一輪 2026 年 10 月 4 日–2027 年 2 月 1 日；第二輪 2027 年 2 月 2 日–5 月 17 日；5 月 17 日後僅在有名額時考慮。不會只憑申請表錄取，入選者須面試；設計背景交五個項目作品集 PDF。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 gold.ac.uk 課程頁與研究所申請說明查核；學費、截止與入學條件每年可能調整，送件前請再看官網。

封面為本校校園建築脈絡，並非本課學生作品。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（The Ben Pimlott Building, Goldsmiths College - geograph.org.uk - 337212.jpg，Bill Cresswell，CC BY-SA 2.0；縮圖）

為什麼選 Expanded Practice，而不是 Computational Arts？

兩者都在金匠、都常見於設計／互動申請清單，但定位不同：

  • MA Design: Expanded Practice（Design）：工作室主題含溝通與體驗、互動與實驗等，作品集＋面試是設計申請主路徑，適合想擴張設計實踐邊界的人。
  • MA Computational Arts 是另一個可獨立查閱的課程；兩課的學制、費用與申請規則不能互換。本篇不列該課的數字。

本篇以作品集導向的 Expanded Practice 為主文；若你的核心是 creative coding／computational art，改對照 Computational Arts 頁面數字。

課程怎麼運作？2027/28 有哪些工作室？

全長約五個 10–11 週學期、每週至少四天。三大模組：Studio Expanded Practice（120）、Design Transfocality（60）、Extended Study（30）。先以共同 brief 建立cohort 合作，再選定工作室每週深耕；之後跨工作室選題，暑假可做巴黎暑校或外部實習類 Extended Study，最後一學期回到校園整合成公開成果（出版／展覽／座談等）。

2027/28 Studios：Communication & Experience；Fashions & Embodiment；Speculation & Futures；Interactions & Experiments；Spaces & Participation；Culture & Ecologies。申請時須填第一、第二志願工作室。

2027 申請截止與文件要求？

Round 1：2026/10/4–2027/2/1；Round 2：2027/2/2–5/17。設計背景：五個相關項目（含草圖、過程、實驗與迭代）＋ 500–1,000 英文單字的反思，合成一份名為 Portfolio 的 PDF。非設計背景：500–700 英文單字的陳述＋ Creative Document。個人陳述須依系統欄位填寫（為何選此課、學術背景、其他經驗、長期目標等）。面試常問背景如何形塑實踐、對課程的期待、以及工作室志願；海外申請者可線上面試。

學費與英語？

2027/2028 起讀者：Home £14,900、International £30,700。因是 15 個月學制，英國 postgraduate loan 撥款時程可能與繳費期錯開，官網提醒須注意在第三學期結束前繳清學費。IELTS 6.5／寫作 6.5／其餘 ≥6.0。官網申請說明未列申請費（以送件當下系統為準）。

適合誰？

適合已有設計或相關創意實踐、想把方法與議題拉開到社會／批判層次的人；也歡迎教學、社科、策展、工程、科學、商業等「實踐」背景，但須在作品集或面試展現進階設計思考。若只想學標準 UX 工具流、不想進入後學科工作室文化，可能更適合其他以 UX 為名的課程（例如拉夫堡 User Experience Design）。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、選工作室與梳理項目敘事；任何學費與截止日仍以送件當下的金匠官網為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: Goldsmiths’ MA Design: Expanded Practice (School of Design) is a 15-month full-time post-disciplinary design master’s. Published fees for students starting in 2027/2028: Home £14,900, International £30,700. English: IELTS 6.5 with 6.5 in writing and no element lower than 6.0. Rounds: 4 Oct 2026–1 Feb 2027 and 2 Feb–17 May 2027; after 17 May only if spaces remain. No offers on application alone—shortlisted applicants interview; design applicants submit a five-project portfolio PDF.

Figures checked on 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) on gold.ac.uk programme and postgraduate apply pages. Re-check before you apply.

The cover shows university campus architecture, not student work from this programme. Image: Wikimedia Commons（The Ben Pimlott Building, Goldsmiths College - geograph.org.uk - 337212.jpg，Bill Cresswell，CC BY-SA 2.0；resized）

Why Expanded Practice rather than Computational Arts?

Expanded Practice is the School of Design portfolio route with studios such as Communication & Experience and Interactions & Experiments. MA Computational Arts is a separate programme: check its own duration, fees and application rules rather than borrowing numbers from this article.

How does the course run, and which Studios exist for 2027/28?

Five 10–11 week terms, at least four days a week. Modules: Studio Expanded Practice (120), Design Transfocality (60), Extended Study (30). Shared opening brief, weekly Studio, cross-Studio projects, summer Extended Study (e.g. Paris summer school or placement), then a public-facing culmination. 2027/28 Studios: Communication & Experience; Fashions & Embodiment; Speculation & Futures; Interactions & Experiments; Spaces & Participation; Culture & Ecologies—list first and second choices in your statement.

Deadlines and documents for 2027?

Round 1 4 Oct 2026–1 Feb 2027; Round 2 2 Feb–17 May 2027. Design portfolios: five projects with process plus 500–1,000 words reflection as one PDF. Non-design: 500–700 word statement plus Creative Document. Interview required for selected applicants.

Fees and English?

2027/2028 starters: Home £14,900, International £30,700. IELTS 6.5 / writing 6.5 / no element below 6.0. No application fee listed on official apply pages checked November 2026.

Who is this master’s for?

Practitioners ready to expand design beyond fixed specialisms into critical and social work; related non-design practices are welcome if research or creative evidence is strong. If you only want a conventional UX toolkit course, a named UX master’s (e.g. Loughborough) may fit better.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants check official figures, pick Studios and shape project stories—always re-check Goldsmiths’ live pages when you submit.

a.en: 15 months full-time across five 10–11 week terms (minimum four days a week), for 2027/2028 entry.

q.en: What IELTS score do I need?

a.zh-Hant: IELTS 6.5，寫作 6.5，其餘不低於 6.0。
a.en: 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and no element lower than 6.0.

q.zh-Hant: 申請截止日是什麼時候？
q.en: When are the deadlines?

a.zh-Hant: 第一輪至 2027 年 2 月 1 日；第二輪至 2027 年 5 月 17 日；之後僅在有名額時考慮。

q.en: Portfolio, interview, application fee?

a.en: Yes portfolio (five projects for design applicants) and interview if shortlisted. No application fee listed on official pages checked.

q.zh-Hant: Computational Arts 可以當備選嗎？
q.en: Is Computational Arts a valid alternate?

a.zh-Hant: 可另行對照，但它是不同課程，學制、學費、語言與申請截止須分別查閱官方頁面，本篇不提供該課未重新核實的數字。
a.en: You can compare it separately, but it is a different programme. Check its own duration, fees, English requirements and deadlines; this article does not give unverified figures for it.

title.en: How do you apply to PolyU School of Design’s MDes Smart Service Design? One year, HK$7,800 per credit, IELTS 6.0 and the 2027 entry application deadline (checked November 2026)

body.zh-Hant:
結論先講：理大設計學院 Master of Design — Smart Service Design（SSD）把服務設計放在商業、科技與人的交會，強調社會技術系統、端到端旅程與永續服務體驗。官網專修頁標 Entrance Year 2027：混合模式、全日制 1 年／兼讀 3 年、畢業需 37 學分；學費 HK$7,800／學分，並註明 1 學分 AIE 科目不收學費（以 36 學分計約 HK$280,800）。申請自 2026 年 7 月 2 日起；早鳥截止 2026 年 10 月 20 日、主要輪 2027 年 2 月 25 日。須作品集，且所有錄取都要經過面試。大學 Taught Postgraduate 2027/28 申請費 HK$600。

目前狀態：早輪已於 2026 年 10 月 20 日截止；主要輪截止為 2027 年 2 月 25 日。

以下數字於 2026 年 11 月 8 日（Asia/Taipei）對照 polyu.edu.hk 設計學院 SSD 介紹／申請頁、大學 TPG 入學英語要求與申請費說明查核。不要把舊年度 FAQ 的費用套到 2027 入學。送件前請再看官網。

封面為本校校園建築脈絡，並非本課學生作品。圖片來源：Wikimedia Commons（Innovation Tower, HK PolyU in 2019 (1).jpg，Timothytyy，CC BY-SA 4.0；裁切、縮圖）

為什麼 SSD 以服務系統為核心？

SSD 強調服務生態系、利害關係人與系統創新，不只是畫單一產品介面。選課時先確認自己能否把使用者需求連到組織、商業與科技脈絡，再用項目過程證明這種能力。

Smart Service Design 學什麼？

官網定位：在商業、科技與人文交會處做有影響力的服務介入；超越單純 UX、資訊設計或產品設計，整合設計、商業、科技與人的需求。透過演講、工作室、工作坊與產業研究項目，在數位與線下通路創造、轉化與評估服務產品與內容。畢業出路涵蓋消費電子、移動、醫療、旅遊餐旅、金融與公共服務等領域的設計、管理與策略角色。

2027 申請時程與文件？

SSD Application 頁：

  • 開放：2026-07-02
  • 早鳥：2026-10-20
  • 主要輪：2027-02-25

完整申請含：申請表、個人陳述、兩封推薦信（學術／工作）、學位證明與最終正式成績單、作品集（詳見 eProspectus Guidance Notes）、以及視情況提交的 IELTS／TOEFL。短名單以面洽或線上面試進行；沒有面試就不能完成錄取流程。非本地生錄取後簽證常需 8–10 週，宜早規劃。

學費、申請費與英語要求？

SSD 頁（Entrance Year 2027）：HK$7,800／學分；AIE 1 學分免學費。以 36 學分估算總學費約 HK$280,800。非本地全日制初始註冊學分數頁面列為 12（本地全日制 9、本地兼讀 6）。大學 TPG FAQ：2027/28 申請費 HK$600（不可退、不可轉）。

英語（大學 TPG 通用門檻）：非英語母語且學士非英語授課者，須在兩年內一次考取——IELTS Academic 總分 6.0 或以上；或 TOEFL iBT 80／120（2026 年 1 月 21 日起考者亦可為 4.5／6）。不接受 Home Edition、IELTS Online、Indicator、One Skill Retake。是否符合語言豁免須依學歷及正式授課語言證明，由校方個案核定。

入學條件與適合誰？

需設計、商業、人文或科技領域學士（或同等）；其他專上資歷搭配充足相關專業經驗可個案審。適合想做服務生態系、公共／商業服務創新，並能用作品集與面試講清系統與利害關係人視角的申請者。名額有限，2026 年 10 月 20 日早輪已過；目前應依主要輪期限盡早準備。

我們以 12,000+ 小時設計教學與設計諮詢的實務經驗，陪申請者對照官網數字、整理服務設計項目與面試敘事；任何學費與截止日仍以送件當下的理大／設計學院官網為準。

尚待確認：截至 2026 年 11 月 8 日，未確認延長輪日期或 SSD 作品集的固定頁數；請以 eProspectus Guidance Notes 與個人通知為準。課程頁只列單一學分單價，不能據此保證本地與非本地各身分費率完全相同，以錄取文件核定為準。
body.en:
Bottom line: PolyU School of Design’s Master of Design — Smart Service Design (SSD) sits at business × technology × human ingenuity, with a socio-technical, systemic and human-centred take on service design. The specialism page lists Entrance Year 2027: mixed mode, 1 year full-time / 3 years part-time, 37 credits; tuition HK$7,800 per credit with the 1-credit AIE subject untuitioned (≈ HK$280,800 for 36 credits). Applications open 2 July 2026; Early 20 October 2026, Main 25 February 2027. Portfolio required; every admission goes through interview. University TPG 2027/28 application fee HK$600.

Current status: the 20 October 2026 early round has closed. The main-round deadline is 25 February 2027.

Figures checked on 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei) against polyu.edu.hk SSD pages, TPG English requirements and application-fee FAQs. Do not reuse fees from an older intake’s FAQ. Re-check before you apply.

The cover shows university campus architecture, not student work from this programme. Image: Wikimedia Commons（Innovation Tower, HK PolyU in 2019 (1).jpg，Timothytyy，CC BY-SA 4.0；cropped and resized）

Why does SSD focus on service systems?

SSD links service ecosystems, stakeholders and systems innovation rather than focusing only on a single product interface. Show how your work connects human needs with organisations, business and technology.

What does Smart Service Design teach?

Impactful service interventions beyond UX, information or product design alone—integrating design, business, technology and human needs through lectures, studios, workshops and industry research projects. Career contexts listed include consumer electronics, mobility, healthcare, tourism and hospitality, finance and public service.

2027 timeline and documents?

Open 2026-07-02; Early 2026-10-20; Main 2027-02-25. Pack: form, personal statement, two references, certificates/transcripts, portfolio (eProspectus notes), IELTS/TOEFL if required. Interview mandatory (in person or online). Non-local visa processing often 8–10 weeks after offer.

Fees, application fee and English?

SSD Entrance Year 2027: HK$7,800/credit (AIE free). Non-local FT initial registration credits: 12. Application fee HK$600 (2027/28). English when required: IELTS Academic 6.0+ or TOEFL iBT 80/120 (or 4.5/6 for tests from 21 Jan 2026); Home Edition / Online / Indicator / one-skill retake not accepted.

Who is this master’s for?

Bachelor’s in design, business, humanities or technology (or equivalent); other tertiary study plus substantial relevant experience case-by-case. Best for applicants who can evidence service-ecosystem and stakeholder thinking in portfolio and interview. The 20 October 2026 early round has already passed; prepare promptly for the main round.

With 12,000+ hours of design teaching and design consulting, we help applicants check official figures and shape service-design project and interview stories—always re-check PolyU’s live pages when you submit.

Still unverified: as of 8 November 2026 (Asia/Taipei), no extended-round date or fixed SSD portfolio page count has been confirmed. Follow the eProspectus Guidance Notes and your individual instructions. A single displayed per-credit rate does not by itself confirm identical fees for every local/non-local status; check your offer.

keywords: Master of Design — Smart Service Design (MDes SSD) 2027

IELTS Academic overall 6.0 or above (if not native speaker and Bachelor not taught in English); OR TOEFL iBT 80/120 or 4.5/6 for tests on/after 21 Jan 2026. Home Edition / Online / Indicator / one-skill retake not accepted.

a.zh-Hant: 全日制 1 年／兼讀 3 年（混合模式），畢業 37 學分（含免學費的 1 學分 AIE）。

q.zh-Hant: 2027 學費多少？

a.zh-Hant: Entrance Year 2027 頁列 HK$7,800／學分；AIE 1 學分不收費，36 個收費學分估算 HK$280,800。各身分適用費率仍須以錄取文件確認。
a.en: The Entrance Year 2027 page lists HK$7,800 per credit, with the 1-credit AIE subject untuitioned: about HK$280,800 for 36 charged credits. Confirm the rate applicable to your status in your offer.

q.zh-Hant: 雅思要多少？
q.en: What IELTS score do I need?

a.zh-Hant: 適用者需 IELTS Academic 總分 6.0 或以上，或符合官方適用量尺的 TOEFL iBT。豁免須依本人學歷與授課語言證明，由校方核定。
a.en: When required: IELTS Academic overall 6.0+ or qualifying TOEFL iBT under the applicable scoring scale. Any exemption depends on your degree, official medium-of-instruction evidence and the university’s decision.

q.zh-Hant: 申請截止日是什麼時候？
q.en: When are the deadlines?

a.en: Opened 2 July 2026; the 20 October 2026 early round has passed. Main round: 25 February 2027. No extended round has been confirmed.

a.en: Portfolio required; interview mandatory for admission. Application fee HK$600 for 2027/28 TPG.

q.zh-Hant: 有作品集固定頁數或延長輪公告嗎？

a.zh-Hant: 本輪尚未確認。需作品集，但不要自行套用其他專修或舊年度頁數；以最新 eProspectus Guidance Notes、申請系統與個人通知為準。
